gameplay: Menu-based fortune telling and astrology simulation.
objetivo: To receive personal divinations and compatibility readings based on user input.
descripcion_corta: A fortune-telling simulator based on Japanese astrology and numerology.
descripcion_larga: This Japan-exclusive title allows players to input their birth date and other personal data to receive astrological predictions. It features various divination methods, including tarot-style readings and personality analysis through a digital interface.

gameplay: Inventory-based adventure platformer with puzzle-solving elements.
objetivo: Rescue Prince Mylo from the evil wizard Zaks' castle.
descripcion_corta: A handheld-style adventure featuring the egg-shaped hero Dizzy in a magical world.
descripcion_larga: Originally released for the Aladdin Deck Enhancer, this game follows Dizzy as he navigates a fairy-tale land. Players must collect items and use them in the correct locations to overcome obstacles and solve environmental puzzles to progress through the story.

gameplay: Open-world adventure platformer featuring item management and puzzles.
objetivo: Rescue Daisy and the rest of the Yolkfolk from the evil wizard Zaks.
descripcion_corta: An expansive adventure game where Dizzy must explore a vast kingdom to save his friends.
descripcion_larga: Considered one of the most complex entries in the series, players guide Dizzy through a large interconnected world. The game requires careful inventory management, as Dizzy can only carry three items at a time, forcing players to prioritize objects needed to solve local puzzles.

gameplay: Top-down miniature vehicular racing with high-speed handling.
objetivo: Finish in the top positions across various household-themed tracks.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced racing game featuring tiny vehicles in everyday environments.
descripcion_larga: Players control miniature cars, boats, and tanks through tracks set on kitchen tables, desks, and gardens. The game is famous for its "off-screen" elimination mechanic in multiplayer and its challenging AI that requires precise steering and memorization of shortcuts.

gameplay: American football simulation with basic offensive and defensive plays.
objetivo: Outscore the opponent to progress through five levels of difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A foundational American football title focusing on arcade-style sports action.
descripcion_larga: Players choose between offensive plays (running or passing) and defensive maneuvers. The game progresses through various ranks from High School to Pro, with the difficulty increasing as the player advances through the season.

gameplay: American football simulation with basic offensive and defensive plays.
objetivo: Outscore the opponent to progress through five levels of difficulty.
descripcion_corta: The localized version of the classic arcade-style American football game.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the Japanese release in mechanics, players control a team through various divisions. It features a simplified view of the sport, emphasizing timing and lane positioning rather than complex strategic management.

nombre: 100 Man Dollar Kid - Maboroshi no Teiou Hen (Japan)
gameplay: Board game simulation with gambling and trading mechanics.
objetivo: Accumulate a fortune of 100 million dollars through various games of chance.
descripcion_corta: A digital board game focused on high-stakes gambling and financial success.
descripcion_larga: Players navigate a board to participate in different gambling activities and mini-games. The ultimate goal is to become a "Mister Dollar" by outsmarting opponents and managing luck to reach the titular financial milestone.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with loop-de-loop mechanics.
objetivo: Navigate through enemy-filled skies to reach the end of the stage.
descripcion_corta: A classic WWII-themed shooter where players pilot a P-38 Lightning.
descripcion_larga: Set in the Pacific Theater, players must shoot down waves of enemy aircraft and avoid incoming fire. The game introduced the "roll" mechanic, allowing the player to temporarily become invincible while performing a loop to evade danger.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with energy management and upgrades.
objetivo: Defeat the Japanese naval fleet in the Battle of Midway.
descripcion_corta: A refined WWII shooter featuring a health bar and weapon upgrades.
descripcion_larga: This version represents a pre-release or alternate build of the sequel. It maintains the core vertical shooting action but introduces a "Fuel" meter that acts as both health and super-weapon energy, requiring players to balance aggression with survival.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with energy management and upgrades.
objetivo: Sink the enemy fleet and defeat the massive boss ships.
descripcion_corta: The final US release of the classic WWII naval-aerial combat game.
descripcion_larga: Players fly a P-38 through 16 stages of intense combat. Unlike the first game, players can upgrade their weapons (Auto, 3-Way, Shell) and must manage their energy bar carefully to survive the bullet-filled boss encounters at the end of each mission.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with energy-based health system.
objetivo: Destroy the enemy fleet and bosses across various historical stages.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the classic WWII shooter 1943.
descripcion_larga: Known in Japan as 1943: Midway Kai, this version features updated music, colors, and modified level layouts compared to the original arcade port, offering a fresh take on the P-38 Lightning combat experience.

objetivo: Advance through modified levels to defeat enemy forces.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made modification of 1943 intended to simulate a sequel.
descripcion_larga: This is a modified version of 1943 - The Battle of Midway. It typically features palette swaps and altered level designs to create the illusion of a new game in the 19XX series on the NES hardware.

gameplay: Board game/Sugoroku style simulation with mini-games.
objetivo: Navigate the board to survive and succeed during the "end of the century."
descripcion_corta: A quirky Japanese board game themed around the turn of the millennium.
descripcion_larga: Based on end-of-the-world prophecies popular in the late 90s, players move across a board facing various life events, financial challenges, and mini-games to see who can come out on top by the year 1999.

nombre: 2 in 1 Lightgun Game - Tough Cop + Super Tough Cop (Asia) (Unl)
gameplay: Lightgun-based shooting (Zapper) from a first-person perspective.
objetivo: Apprehend criminals and survive shootouts as a police officer.
descripcion_corta: A compilation of two unlicensed "Tough Cop" lightgun shooters.
descripcion_larga: These games utilize the NES Zapper. Players take the role of a police officer in urban environments, shooting at criminals who appear on screen while avoiding civilians to clear stages and maintain order.

gameplay: Multi-cart containing three distinct shooting/action games.
objetivo: Complete various challenges across three different titles.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed compilation of action games designed for lightgun or controller.
descripcion_larga: This "Supergun" multi-cart typically includes simplified arcade-style games. Like many unlicensed Asian titles, these games focus on high-score chasing and repetitive but challenging gameplay loops.

objetivo: Run and jump through eight worlds to save Princess DoReMi.
descripcion_corta: A 3D-perspective platformer similar to Space Harrier.
descripcion_larga: Players control Jack the WorldRunner as he runs constantly into the screen. The game features an optional 3D mode (using red/blue glasses) and requires precise jumping over bottomless pits and dodging alien enemies.

gameplay: Falling block puzzle game (Tetris clone) with a 3D perspective.
objetivo: Clear lines of blocks to prevent the screen from filling up.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 3D-style interpretation of the Tetris formula.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Hwang Shinwei, this game tilts the Tetris playfield to create a pseudo-3D look. Players must rotate and place falling pieces to create solid lines, featuring the typical escalating difficulty of the genre.

gameplay: Falling block puzzle game with modified visuals.
objetivo: Strategically place blocks to clear lines and gain points.
descripcion_corta: Another unlicensed variation of the 3D block puzzle concept.
descripcion_larga: Similar to other 3D Block versions but with slight variations in graphics and sound depending on the RCM Group's publishing. It offers a unique visual perspective on the traditional brick-stacking gameplay.

gameplay: Four-player Mahjong simulation based on standard Japanese rules.
objetivo: Win hands to take points from opponents and finish with the highest score.
descripcion_corta: One of the earliest 4-player Mahjong games for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: This title brought the traditional Japanese tabletop game to the console. It features AI opponents with different playstyles and focuses on the Riichi Mahjong ruleset, emphasizing strategy and tile counting.

objetivo: Defeat three AI opponents in a series of Mahjong matches.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the classic 4-player Mahjong game.
descripcion_larga: This "Revision A" version contains minor bug fixes and potential adjustments to the AI or scoring logic from the original 1984 release, providing a more stable gambling simulation experience.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer (Graphic hack of The Flintstones).
objetivo: Reach the end of the levels while defeating enemies with a club.
descripcion_corta: A famous bootleg modification of The Flintstones: Rescue of Dino & Hoppy.
descripcion_larga: This notorious pirate hack replaces Fred Flintstone's head with a modified Mario head. It became an internet meme but retains the solid platforming mechanics and level design of the original official title.

gameplay: Isometric skateboarding with time-limit based navigation.
objetivo: Earn enough tickets to enter the Skate Park and perform stunts.
descripcion_corta: An arcade-style skateboarding game set in a suburban neighborhood.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate a "skate city" to reach four different parks (Downhill, Jump, Slalom, and Ramp) before time runs out. The game is known for its unique control scheme and the infamous "Skate or Die!" warning when time expires.

gameplay: Action-adventure platformer with a controllable bird companion.
objetivo: Defeat the eight dukes and recover the eight power gems.
descripcion_corta: A post-apocalyptic action game often compared to Castlevania.
descripcion_larga: Set in a future where the world has been rebuilt after nuclear war, players control Orin and his falcon, Cutrus. The game allows for two-player co-op where one player controls the bird to flip switches and attack enemies.

gameplay: Action-adventure platformer with a controllable bird companion.
objetivo: Recover the Great Jewels of the eight power centers to save the world.
descripcion_corta: The North American localized version of the challenging action title.
descripcion_larga: Similar to the Japanese version but with rebalanced difficulty and localized text. Players must choose the order in which they tackle the eight mansions, each representing a different country and containing a unique boss.

objetivo: Complete various Christmas-themed levels and challenges.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed holiday-themed game featuring festive sprites.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg title is often a modification of existing games or a collection of simple assets. It uses Christmas imagery, such as Santa Claus and snowy environments, to provide a seasonal, albeit unpolished, experience.

gameplay: Train-themed business simulation and city building.
objetivo: Build a successful railway network and manage urban development.
descripcion_corta: A strategic railway management game (part of the A-Train series).
descripcion_larga: Players act as a railway tycoon, laying tracks, managing train schedules, and developing the surrounding land. Success depends on balancing the budget while growing the city's population through efficient transport links.

objetivo: Guide Garfield through a week of chores and obstacles to find Odie.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype version of the Garfield licensed game.
descripcion_larga: Players control the famous cat as he kicks enemies like mice and spiders. This prototype version shows the early development stages of the game, which is notorious for its high difficulty and small character sprites.

gameplay: Life simulation and baseball management hybrid.
objetivo: Navigate a player's life from childhood to professional baseball success.
descripcion_corta: A unique "Life of Baseball" simulation game.
descripcion_larga: Combining board game elements with sports management, players make life choices that affect their character's stats. The goal is to balance training, personal life, and career milestones to become a legendary baseball star.

objetivo: Navigate the innards of a giant alien to rescue Princess Maria.
descripcion_corta: A grotesque, biological-themed shooter known for its difficulty.
descripcion_larga: In this "Inner-Body" shooter, players fly through organic environments filled with guts and bones. The game is famous for its high level of gore for the era and a punishing difficulty curve where one hit results in death.

objetivo: Enter the alien entity Abadox and destroy it from the inside.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the biological sci-fi shooter.
descripcion_larga: Identical in gameplay to the Japanese version, players must master power-up management to survive. It features a mix of horizontal and vertical scrolling stages, concluding in a battle against the alien's core.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer based on the movie Aladdin.
objetivo: Navigate through Agrabah to find Princess Jasmine and defeat Jafar.
descripcion_corta: A bootleg platformer featuring characters from Disney's Aladdin.
descripcion_larga: This is an unlicensed title often found on multi-carts. Players control Aladdin through various levels inspired by the film, collecting items and jumping across rooftops. It is known for its unpolished physics and repurposed assets from other games.

gameplay: Flight combat simulation from a first-person cockpit view.
objetivo: Complete various aerial missions and shoot down enemy aircraft.
descripcion_corta: A military flight simulator based on the Iron Eagle III movie.
descripcion_larga: Players pilot a fighter jet through several missions involving dogfights and bombing runs. The game focuses on managing radar, altitude, and weapon systems to intercept enemy targets while following a storyline tied to the film.

gameplay: Multigame compilation featuring 52 different simple games.
objetivo: Try out 52 different titles, ranging from shooters to platformers.
descripcion_corta: A notorious unlicensed collection of 52 low-quality games.
descripcion_larga: Famous for its high retail price and poor quality, this cart contains 52 original games (like Cheetahmen). Most suffer from bugs, unfinished levels, and repetitive gameplay, making it a legendary piece of gaming history for the wrong reasons.

objetivo: Navigate through a library of 52 games with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the infamous Action 52 multicart.
descripcion_larga: This "Rev A" version attempted to fix some of the game-breaking bugs found in the initial release. While it remains largely the same collection of low-budget titles, some games that previously crashed or were unplayable were slightly improved.

gameplay: Side-scrolling shoot 'em up with futuristic vehicles.
objetivo: Defeat an alien invasion to protect the city of New York.
descripcion_corta: The European version of the shooter known as SCAT: Special Cybernetic Attack Team.
descripcion_larga: Players control a human soldier equipped with a jetpack and two orbiting "bits" that provide extra firepower. The game features intense action, challenging bosses, and the ability to change the direction of your fire while moving.

objetivo: Search the Addams mansion to find hidden items for a scavenger hunt.
descripcion_corta: A prototype/beta version of Pugsley's adventure in the Addams house.
descripcion_larga: In this European beta, players control Pugsley as he explores the non-linear mansion. The game is based on the animated series and requires finding specific objects while avoiding surreal enemies and hazards.

objetivo: Explore the mansion and find your family members' hidden items.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt.
descripcion_larga: Based on "The Addams Family" animated series, this game puts Pugsley in the lead. He must navigate various themed rooms in the mansion (like the attic and laboratory), jumping on enemies and uncovering secret passages to complete his task.

nombre: Addams Family, The - Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt (Europe) (Beta)
gameplay: Top-down action-adventure with exploration and shooting.
objetivo: Find and destroy the alien mother ship hidden under the city.
descripcion_corta: A challenging adventure game starring Uncle Fester.
descripcion_larga: Unlike other Addams Family games, this is a top-down shooter. Fester must navigate the streets and sewers, upgrade his lightning gun, and find items to help him enter the alien craft. It is known for its high difficulty and lack of a save system in the original version.

nombre: Addams Family, The - Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt (USA)
gameplay: Top-down action-adventure with exploration and shooting.
objetivo: Repel an alien invasion by locating their hidden base.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of Fester's Quest.
descripcion_larga: Players guide Uncle Fester through a large, interconnected world. The game combines shooting mechanics with overhead exploration and first-person maze sections inside buildings. It features cameos from other family members who provide helpful power-ups.

nombre: Addams Family, The - Uncle Fester's Quest (Europe)
gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer with a large interconnected world.
objetivo: Rescue the Addams family members from the mansion's vaults.
descripcion_corta: A platformer based on the 1991 Addams Family movie.
descripcion_larga: Players control Gomez as he searches his mansion and grounds for kidnapped family members. The game is known for its non-linear exploration, hidden secrets, and the need to collect a specific amount of money to progress to the final boss.

nombre: Addams Family, The - Uncle Fester's Quest (USA)
objetivo: Complete various aerial missions to defeat the evil dragon armies of Takhisis.
descripcion_corta: A unique dragon-riding flight simulator set in the Dragonlance world.
descripcion_larga: Players choose from three types of dragons (Gold, Silver, or Bronze) and fly through 27 missions. The gameplay involves aerial dogfights, avoiding ground fire, and using dragon breath or physical attacks to destroy enemy targets in a 3D-scrolling environment.

objetivo: Retrieve the Disks of Mishakal from the ruined city of Pax Tharkas.
descripcion_corta: An action-oriented RPG based on the first Dragonlance novel.
descripcion_larga: Players control a party of ten heroes, switching between them to utilize different skills. The game focuses on combat and exploration in a side-scrolling perspective, requiring players to manage character health and magic to survive the dangerous ruins.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action-adventure with party management (English Translation).
objetivo: Recover the Disks of Mishakal to bring back the knowledge of the true gods.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the Japanese Dragonlance RPG.
descripcion_larga: This version provides a complete English translation of the Japanese release. It allows players to experience the challenging party-based combat and story with all menus and dialogues translated, making the complex D&D mechanics accessible to English speakers.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action-platformer with a large party of characters.
objetivo: Venture into the pits of Xak Tsaroth to retrieve the Disks of Mishakal.
descripcion_corta: A challenging action RPG based on the legendary Dragonlance campaign.
descripcion_larga: Players lead a group of eight heroes through a dangerous dungeon. The game is known for its high difficulty and the need to swap characters constantly, as each hero has specific strengths, such as Tanis's sword or Raistlin's magic, essential for survival.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Dragons of Flame (Japan)
gameplay: Side-scrolling action-platformer with a large party of characters.
objetivo: Explore the ruins of Xak Tsaroth and recover the ancient Disks of Mishakal.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the first Dragonlance title for NES.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the Japanese version, this port brings the tabletop experience to the console. It features a unique control scheme where players manage a line of heroes, navigating traps and fighting dragons in a quest to restore faith to the world of Krynn.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Dragons of Flame (Japan) [En by DvD v1.03]
gameplay: Compilation of diverse mini-games and RPG exploration.
objetivo: Complete various tasks and trials in the city of Hillsfar to earn gold and fame.
descripcion_corta: A multi-genre RPG focused on mini-games and character building.
descripcion_larga: Unlike traditional RPGs, gameplay consists of traveling between locations via a horseback riding mini-game and completing challenges like lock-picking, arena fighting, and archery. It serves as a side-story where players can transfer characters to other D&D titles.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Heroes of the Lance (Japan)
gameplay: Compilation of diverse mini-games and RPG exploration.
objetivo: Master the trials of Hillsfar and build a powerful character.
descripcion_corta: The localized US version of the unique multi-genre D&D adventure.
descripcion_larga: This version features the same mix of mini-games and exploration. Players must navigate the city, interact with NPCs, and succeed in skill-based challenges to progress. It is noted for its departure from standard turn-based D&D combat in favor of arcade-style segments.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Heroes of the Lance (USA)
gameplay: Turn-based tactical RPG with first-person exploration.
objetivo: Defeat the evil boss Tyranthraxus and liberate the city of Phlan.
descripcion_corta: A faithful console adaptation of the classic "Gold Box" PC RPG.
descripcion_larga: Players create a custom party of six characters and explore a grid-based world. Combat shifts to a tactical top-down view where positioning and spell management are key. It is one of the most complex and deep RPG experiences available on the NES.

gameplay: Turn-based tactical RPG with first-person exploration.
objetivo: Reclaim the city of Phlan from the forces of evil.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the iconic Gold Box RPG.
descripcion_larga: This version brings the full D&D experience to the NES, including character creation, experience leveling, and complex tactical combat. Players must clear various sectors of the city and complete quests to restore Phlan to its former glory.

gameplay: Collection of mini-games based on Disney park attractions.
objetivo: Find six silver keys to open the castle gate for the big parade.
descripcion_corta: A Disney-themed adventure featuring various arcade-style levels.
descripcion_larga: Players explore the park and enter attractions to play mini-games: a racing game (Autopia), a space shooter (Space Mountain), a boat ride (Pirates of the Caribbean), and more. It also includes trivia questions from Disney characters to earn the final keys.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Pool of Radiance (Japan)
gameplay: Multi-genre action: beat 'em up, lightgun shooting, and driving.
objetivo: Rescue Billy's girlfriend, Annabelle, from the gang boss Gordon.
descripcion_corta: A diverse action game set in the Louisiana swamplands.
descripcion_larga: Players experience three distinct gameplay styles: side-scrolling fighting, first-person rail shooting (compatible with the Zapper), and top-down driving. The European version is known for being slightly more balanced in difficulty than the US release.

nombre: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Pool of Radiance (USA)
gameplay: Multi-genre action: beat 'em up, lightgun shooting, and driving.
objetivo: Fight through the bayou and the city to save Annabelle.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult multi-genre action title by Konami.
descripcion_larga: This version is famous for its extreme difficulty level. Players must master hand-to-hand combat against crocodiles and thugs, precise shooting in first-person stages, and high-speed driving to reach the final showdown at Gordon's mansion.

objetivo: Recover three stolen treasures from the planet Omsoc.
descripcion_corta: A console port of the classic PC "Metroidvania-lite" adventure.
descripcion_larga: Players control Captain Comic through various interconnected environments. The game focuses on finding power-ups like the "Blastola Cola" to enhance weapons and items like boots or lanterns to access new areas in a non-linear fashion.

objetivo: Navigate through prehistoric lands to defeat the Great Spirit.
descripcion_corta: An overhead action game where a caveman shoots projectiles.
descripcion_larga: Despite the top-down perspective, players must jump over pits while shooting enemies. Dino Riki can upgrade his weapon from rocks to axes, boomerangs, and torches. The game is known for its fast pace and challenging environmental hazards.

objetivo: Collect scattered body parts to reassemble Franken's girlfriend.
descripcion_corta: A prototype of a platformer based on the Frankenstein mythos.
descripcion_larga: Players control Franky, a trendy version of the monster, searching through a large castle and worldwide locations. Since it is a prototype, some mechanics may feel unpolished, but it features puzzle-solving and combat against various supernatural foes.

gameplay: Top-down action-adventure with a companion AI.
objetivo: Find the other castaways and escape the island before it's too late.
descripcion_corta: An adventure game based on the classic 1960s TV sitcom.
descripcion_larga: Players control the Skipper, followed by Gilligan (who is controlled by AI). You must complete tasks, avoid traps, and manage Gilligan's behavior to solve puzzles across several episodes, each mimicking the structure of a TV show.

objetivo: Clear each room of Heart Framers to open the chest and progress.
descripcion_corta: A classic puzzle game starring the round blue hero, Lolo.
descripcion_larga: Players must move blocks, trap enemies in eggs, and use limited power-ups to collect all hearts in a room. It requires deep strategy and planning to avoid being trapped or killed by enemies like Medusas and Don Medusas.

objetivo: Rescue Princess Lala from the clutches of the King of Darkness.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese entry in the Eggerland/Lolo puzzle series.
descripcion_larga: Known in Japan as part of the Eggerland franchise, it features a series of increasingly difficult rooms. The core mechanic involves using the environment and enemy behaviors to clear a path to the exit in a top-down, tile-based world.

objetivo: Solve 50 complex rooms to save Princess Lala.
descripcion_corta: The first official Western release of the beloved puzzle series.
descripcion_larga: This game introduced North American players to Lolo's strategic puzzles. It features 50 levels of logic-based gameplay, where the player must figure out the exact sequence of moves to collect items and reach the exit without getting stuck.

objetivo: Complete a series of custom, high-difficulty puzzle rooms.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made modification designed for expert Lolo players.
descripcion_larga: Created by Sivak Drac, this hack replaces the original levels with brand-new, much more difficult puzzles. It is intended for those who have already mastered the mechanics of the original game and are looking for a significant logical challenge.

objetivo: Scale the tower and defeat the King of Darkness to save Lala.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese sequel to the popular Eggerland puzzle series.
descripcion_larga: Known as Eggerland: Meikyuu no Fukkatsu in Japan, this sequel introduces more complex room layouts and new enemy behaviors. Players must use their wits to manipulate blocks and enemies to collect all Heart Framers and reach the exit of each floor.

objetivo: Advance through 50 rooms and the final tower to rescue Princess Lala.
descripcion_corta: The second Western installment of the iconic puzzle franchise.
descripcion_larga: Lolo returns with more challenging levels. This version includes "Pro" levels for advanced players and introduces more intricate puzzles involving the placement of bridges and the strategic use of enemy eggs to cross water or block line-of-sight attacks.

objetivo: Solve custom, extremely difficult puzzles designed for experts.
descripcion_corta: A high-difficulty fan-made hack of the second Lolo game.
descripcion_larga: Created by Sivak Drac, this modification replaces the original 50 levels with much more punishing puzzles. It is designed specifically for veterans who have mastered every mechanic and enemy pattern of the official series.

nombre: Adventures of Lolo (USA) [Hack by Sivak Drac v1.0] (~Challenging Lolo)
objetivo: Rescue Lolo, Lala, and the inhabitants of the kingdom from the King of Darkness.
descripcion_corta: The third and largest entry in the Lolo puzzle trilogy.
descripcion_larga: This title features 110 different levels and allows players to switch between Lolo and Lala. It introduces an overworld map where players can choose which levels to tackle first, as well as massive boss fights at the end of each world.

objetivo: Stop the King of Darkness by solving puzzles across various lands.
descripcion_corta: The final official NES chapter of the Lolo series in North America.
descripcion_larga: Considered the peak of the series, Lolo 3 offers a massive variety of puzzles. The ability to play as either Lolo or Lala is purely cosmetic, but the level design reaches its most creative point, requiring precise timing and complex logical deduction.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with gravity-defying mechanics.
objetivo: Travel between planets to reactivate the communication satellites.
descripcion_corta: A quirky sci-fi adventure featuring planet-hopping gameplay.
descripcion_larga: Players control Rad Gravity as he visits multiple planets, each with its own unique gravity and environmental theme. The game is known for its humor, non-linear exploration, and the way it forces players to adapt to changing physics in every world.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with gravity-defying mechanics.
objetivo: Find the hidden Compuminds on different planets to save the galaxy.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the planet-hopping platformer.
descripcion_larga: This version features the same exploration-based gameplay. Rad must find items and interact with strange aliens to progress. It stands out for its creative level design, such as a planet where everything is upside down and another made entirely of trash.

nombre: Adventures of Lolo 2 (USA) [Hack by Sivak Drac v1.0] (~Challenging Lolo 2)
objetivo: Collect the lost pieces of the "Louse-e-um" artifacts.
descripcion_corta: A licensed title based on the classic cartoon series.
descripcion_larga: Players control Rocky the Flying Squirrel and Bullwinkle the Moose. The gameplay alternates between standard platforming and mini-games like football or training exercises. It captures the humor of the show but is known for its high and sometimes frustrating difficulty.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer based on the classic novel.
objetivo: Rescue Becky Thatcher and defeat Injun Joe in a dream world.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese-developed platformer starring the famous literary character.
descripcion_larga: In this adaptation, Tom Sawyer dreams of a fantastic adventure. He travels through various levels (forests, rivers, and haunted houses) using rocks as projectiles. The game features cameos from other characters like Huckleberry Finn and Jim.

objetivo: Navigate through levels to reach the end of the quest.
descripcion_corta: A modern homebrew game created for the NES hardware.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Bob Rost as part of a university project/homebrew initiative, this title serves as an example of modern coding for vintage hardware. It features basic platforming mechanics and serves as a tribute to the 8-bit era's design philosophy.

objetivo: Shoot down waves of enemy jets and survive the gauntlet.
descripcion_corta: A port of Sega's high-speed arcade flight action game.
descripcion_larga: As the pilot of an F-14 Tomcat, players must dodge incoming missiles and use machine guns and lock-on missiles to destroy enemy formations. It is known for its intense speed and scaled sprite effects that attempt to mimic the arcade original.

objetivo: Discover your fortune and personality traits through questions.
descripcion_corta: A virtual astrology guide featuring "Ai Sensei."
descripcion_larga: This title is a digital fortune-telling tool. Players input personal information like birth dates and blood types, and the character Ai Sensei provides horoscopes, compatibility checks, and advice based on Japanese pop-astrology.

nombre: Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends, The (USA)
objetivo: Explore the ruins of Balubalouk to find the King's treasure.
descripcion_corta: A challenging hybrid of platforming and exploration.
descripcion_larga: Players control an explorer in a vast underground world. The game requires careful navigation of traps and the use of bombs to reveal hidden paths. It is known for its non-linear structure and high level of difficulty regarding jump physics.

gameplay: Hybrid of horizontal shoot 'em up and side-scrolling action.
objetivo: Infiltrate and destroy eight floating space fortresses.
descripcion_corta: A two-phase sci-fi action game involving flight and exploration.
descripcion_larga: Each level starts with a flight phase in a jet to reach the fortress. Once inside, the player exits the ship and explores the maze-like interior on foot with a jetpack, managing limited energy while searching for the core to destroy it.

nombre: Adventures of Tomley Kleene by Bob Rost
gameplay: Hybrid of horizontal shoot 'em up and side-scrolling action.
objetivo: Neutralize the alien threat by destroying their sky bases.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the sci-fi hybrid Air Fortress.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the international releases in mechanics, players must master the fuel management system. The "Action" phase inside the fortresses is particularly tense, as the player must find the exit quickly after the reactor is destroyed before it explodes.

gameplay: Hybrid of horizontal shoot 'em up and side-scrolling action.
objetivo: Navigate through space and destroy the cores of eight fortresses.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the cult classic Air Fortress.
descripcion_larga: This version features the same unique blend of genres. The strategic element of saving energy during the flying stages to ensure survival during the interior exploration stages makes it a standout title for fans of tactical shooters.

objetivo: Navigate a manor to find the spell that turns you back into a human.
descripcion_corta: A prototype of the isometric adventure where you play as a ball.
descripcion_larga: In this unreleased port, players control a ball that is constantly losing air. You must find air pumps to stay inflated while navigating rooms filled with spikes and obstacles. This version represents an earlier state of development.

nombre: Ai Sensei no Oshiete - Watashi no Hoshi (Japan)
objetivo: Explore the complex map and survive while managing air levels.
descripcion_corta: A more polished prototype of the isometric puzzle game Airball.
descripcion_larga: This second prototype features updated graphics and physics compared to the first. The gameplay remains focused on careful movement in a pseudo-3D environment, requiring precise jumps and item management to solve environmental puzzles.

nombre: Aigiina no Yogen - From The Legend of Balubalouk (Japan)
gameplay: Side-scrolling flight action based on the TV series.
objetivo: Complete various rescue and infiltration missions with the Airwolf chopper.
descripcion_corta: A European mission-based helicopter combat game.
descripcion_larga: Different from the US version, this release focuses on navigating tight corridors and destroying specific targets. Players must manage fuel and ammo while rescuing hostages and avoiding surface-to-air missiles.

gameplay: Side-scrolling flight action with a focus on shooting.
objetivo: Shoot down enemy planes and progress through multiple stages.
descripcion_corta: A Kyugo-developed flight shooter based on the Airwolf license.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Acclaim version, this Japanese release is a more straightforward horizontal shooter. Players control the high-tech helicopter, upgrading weapons and engaging in dogfights against fleets of enemy aircraft across various landscapes.

gameplay: Side-scrolling helicopter combat with mission-based objectives.
objetivo: Complete top-secret missions and rescue prisoners of war.
descripcion_corta: An action game based on the hit 80s TV show Airwolf.
descripcion_larga: Players pilot the high-tech helicopter through various side-scrolling stages. The gameplay involves a mix of aerial combat and landing at specific bases to rescue hostages. It is known for its high difficulty and the need to manage limited missiles and fuel.

objetivo: Solve a series of mysterious disappearances linked to a ghost train.
descripcion_corta: A classic Japanese mystery adventure game by Jirou Akagawa.
descripcion_larga: Players take on the role of a detective investigating a rural town. The game uses a command-style interface to talk to witnesses, examine scenes, and gather clues to solve the supernatural mystery of the "Ghost Train."

objetivo: Navigate the neo-Tokyo underworld and uncover the Akira project.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the adventure game based on the Akira movie.
descripcion_larga: This version allows English speakers to experience the branching narrative of the Akira game. Players make choices that follow the film's plot, interacting with characters like Kaneda and Tetsuo through detailed pixel-art scenes and dialogue menus.

objetivo: Follow Kaneda's journey through Neo-Tokyo to find Tetsuo.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese adventure game based on the legendary manga and film.
descripcion_larga: The game plays like a visual novel or digital comic. Players select commands like "Look," "Talk," or "Move" to progress through the story. It is highly regarded for its impressive graphics and faithful recreation of the movie's atmosphere.

objetivo: Escape a haunted mansion filled with traps and demons.
descripcion_corta: A horror-themed adventure game, part of the MacVenture series.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as Shadowgate, this Japanese version features the same punishing gameplay where every wrong move can lead to a gruesome death. Players must solve environmental puzzles and manage their torch light to survive the cursed castle.

gameplay: Turn-based RPG with exploration and party management.
objetivo: Prevent a demon invasion by uniting the human and demon worlds.
descripcion_corta: An RPG based on the classic manga series by Shigeru Mizuki.
descripcion_larga: Players control Akuma-kun, navigating a world map and engaging in turn-based battles. The game features a unique system where you can summon different demons to join your party, each with specific elemental spells and abilities.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with multiple paths and characters.
objetivo: Defeat Count Dracula and his army of darkness in the year 1476.
descripcion_corta: The legendary Japanese version of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse.
descripcion_larga: This version is famous for its VRC6 enhancement chip, which provides superior music and sound effects compared to the US release. Players can play as Trevor Belmont and eventually recruit Alucard, Sypha, or Grant to help them through branching stages.

objetivo: Journey to the heart of the Demon Castle to slay Dracula.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the superior VRC6-equipped Japanese title.
descripcion_larga: This hack translates the menus and dialogue of the Japanese Akumajou Densetsu into English. It allows Western players to enjoy the "definitive" version of the third Castlevania, including the original unedited music and higher difficulty balance.

objetivo: Use the Vampire Killer whip to destroy Dracula in his castle.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom Disk System version of the original Castlevania.
descripcion_larga: Originally released for the Disk System, this version features a save function not present in the international cartridge release. The gameplay remains the foundation of the series: platforming, sub-weapons, and intense boss battles against classic movie monsters.

gameplay: Action platformer with a humorous and lighthearted tone.
objetivo: Defeat the self-proclaimed demon king Galamoth.
descripcion_corta: A "cute-em-up" spinoff of the Castlevania series starring Kid Dracula.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as Kid Dracula, this game parodies the tropes of the main series. Players control a young version of Dracula who can charge up fireballs, turn into a bat, and walk on ceilings through colorful, creative levels.

gameplay: Formula-style racing with simulation and arcade elements.
objetivo: Win the season championship by placing first in various global tracks.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed racing game endorsed by the famous IndyCar driver.
descripcion_larga: Players can customize their car's settings and compete in a full season or a single race. It features a unique "Turbo" mechanic for overtaking and a pit stop system, offering a more technical experience than many other 8-bit racers.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer based on the Disney movie.
objetivo: Navigate through Agrabah to find Princess Jasmine and defeat Jafar.
descripcion_corta: The official European release developed by Virgin Interactive.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the unlicensed versions, this official port features fluid animations and levels that closely follow the film's plot. Players use apples as projectiles and a scimitar for close combat, traversing the Cave of Wonders and the Sultan's Palace.

objetivo: Complete levels inspired by the Aladdin story.
descripcion_corta: A common unlicensed/pirate version of the Aladdin game.
descripcion_larga: Often developed by companies like Hummer Team or Super Game, these unlicensed versions vary in quality. They typically adapt levels from the Genesis or SNES versions of Aladdin, featuring simplified graphics and physics for the NES hardware.

objetivo: Defeat enemies and bosses to progress through the story.
descripcion_corta: A pirate version of Aladdin, often featuring modified assets.
descripcion_larga: Released in 1995, this version is part of the "Aladdin 4" series of bootlegs. It is known for reusing sprites from other games and having hit-or-miss controls, but it attempted to bring the 16-bit experience to the 8-bit NES.

nombre: Akumajou Densetsu (Japan) [En by Vice v1.0] (~Legend of Demon Castle - Castlevania III)
objetivo: Reach the end of each stage while avoiding traps and enemies.
descripcion_corta: An updated 1996 bootleg version of the Aladdin series.
descripcion_larga: Similar to the 1995 version but often with minor color changes or bug fixes. These "Aladdin 4" titles were widely distributed on multi-carts and represent the era of unlicensed Asian development for the Famicom/NES.

objetivo: Navigate enhanced levels with smoother performance.
descripcion_corta: A refined version of the Aladdin bootleg by Hummer Team.
descripcion_larga: This specific version is a "Deluxe" mod of the original Hummer Team pirate game. It aims to fix technical issues, improve sprite animations, and provide a more playable experience than the standard unlicensed releases.

objetivo: Journey through the desert and palaces to save the princess.
descripcion_corta: Another distinct unlicensed sequel/version of the Aladdin story.
descripcion_larga: Labeled as "Aladdin II," this bootleg often features entirely different level layouts and music than the "Aladdin 4" series, though it still relies on assets inspired by the 16-bit Disney games.

nombre: Akumajou Special - Boku Dracula-kun (Japan) [En by Vice v1.04] (~I'm Kid Dracula!!)
gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer with puzzle and flight elements.
objetivo: Find and hatch all the balloons in each level to proceed.
descripcion_corta: A quirky platformer starring a brave chicken.
descripcion_larga: Players control Alfred as he pecks enemies and uses his "dive bomb" move. The game is known for its bright graphics and the unique goal of popping balloons to open the exit, requiring a mix of platforming skill and exploration.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer with puzzle and flight elements.
objetivo: Navigate through the levels to rescue your feathered friends.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Alfred Chicken platformer.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it features challenging levels filled with secret areas and power-ups. Alfred must find his way through various themed worlds, including a toy factory and a haunted house.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action with exploration and time limits.
objetivo: Rescue prisoners and reach the exit before the timer expires.
descripcion_corta: A tense action game based on the sci-fi horror movie.
descripcion_larga: Players control Ripley as she navigates the Fiorina 161 prison colony. Armed with a pulse rifle, flamethrower, and grenades, you must track down trapped prisoners using a motion tracker while fighting off waves of Aliens.

objetivo: Rescue all hostages and reach the exit before the bomb explodes.
descripcion_corta: A port of Sega's arcade classic featuring alien-infested ships.
descripcion_larga: Players move through maze-like spaceships to rescue trapped crew members. After collecting everyone, a boss room opens. The game features various power-ups like lasers and fireballs to combat the grotesque alien biological forms.

objetivo: Clear each deck of aliens and save your teammates.
descripcion_corta: The North American unlicensed version by Tengen.
descripcion_larga: While Sega produced the original, Tengen released this version in the US without Nintendo's license. It maintains the intense arcade gameplay and the iconic boss battles, featuring a distinct graphic style adapted for the NES hardware.

objetivo: Defeat waves of enemies using Predator's combat skills.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed action game based on the famous sci-fi crossover.
descripcion_larga: This is a pirate title, often based on other games like Kyuu Kyoku Tiger or Spartan X. It features the Predator character fighting through levels filled with human and alien enemies, though it lacks the polish of official licensed products.

gameplay: Side-scrolling basketball with a full-court perspective.
objetivo: Outscore the opposing team across a full 82-game season.
descripcion_corta: A sports simulation focusing on 5-on-5 basketball action.
descripcion_larga: The game features a unique perspective where the court scrolls horizontally. Players can choose from different fictional teams, manage substitutions, and execute slam dunks and long-range shots in a quest for the championship.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with armor upgrades.
objetivo: Defeat the invading alien fleet using the SYD spaceship.
descripcion_corta: A classic vertical shooter featuring a complex power-up system.
descripcion_larga: Players collect "S" and "P" tiles to enhance their ship. The most notable mechanic is the "Armor" system, which allows the ship to transform into different combat modes with varying weapon types to suit the enemy patterns.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with armor upgrades.
objetivo: Destroy the boss at the end of each space stage.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the shooter known as ASO.
descripcion_larga: Known for its high difficulty, this version requires players to memorize power-up locations. Managing the energy levels for your special armor is crucial for survival, especially during the bullet-heavy boss encounters in later levels.

objetivo: Transform into a giant to defeat the monsters of the island.
descripcion_corta: A challenging platformer starring an explorer named Amagon.
descripcion_larga: Amagon starts as a weak human with a rifle, but can transform into "Megagon," a powerful giant who punches enemies. The game is infamous for its high difficulty and the need to manage points to maintain the transformation.

objetivo: Navigate the US political landscape to win the Presidential election.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese-made simulation of the United States presidential race.
descripcion_larga: Players manage campaign funds, travel to different states, and participate in debates to gain popular and electoral votes. It is a rare example of a political strategy game on the Famicom, focused on the 1988 election.

gameplay: Quiz show simulation and board game.
objetivo: Answer trivia questions correctly to win a trip across America.
descripcion_corta: A digital version of the popular Japanese TV quiz show.
descripcion_larga: Based on the "Ultra Quiz" format, players compete in trivia rounds and mini-games while traveling across various US cities. The goal is to avoid elimination and reach the final round at the Statue of Liberty.

objetivo: Build a fortune by winning at various casino games.
descripcion_corta: A casino-themed simulation focused on slot machines and luck.
descripcion_larga: Set in a fictional Las Vegas, players navigate menus to play different types of slot machines. The game tracks your winnings as you try to hit the jackpot and live the "American Dream" of becoming a casino millionaire.

gameplay: Action multi-game based on the TV show events.
objetivo: Compete in various athletic challenges to earn points for the final round.
descripcion_corta: A sports-action collection based on the hit 90s TV competition.
descripcion_larga: Players participate in events like Joust, Wall, Powerball, and Assault against the "Gladiators." Success leads to the Eliminator, a final obstacle course. Each event requires different skills, from button-mashing to precise timing and aiming.

objetivo: Use a slingshot to launch birds and destroy all green pigs on the map.
descripcion_corta: A modern bootleg port of the famous mobile game for the NES.
descripcion_larga: This is an unlicensed adaptation of the mobile hit. Players must calculate the trajectory and power of the slingshot to topple structures and eliminate pigs. Despite the hardware limits, it replicates the core "angry birds" mechanic with 8-bit graphics.

objetivo: Investigate ancient myths and stop a dark god from being resurrected.
descripcion_corta: A dark, mythological adventure game based on a manga series.
descripcion_larga: Based on the work of Daijiro Morohoshi, players explore various locations via menus and commands. It combines Japanese folklore with a cosmic horror atmosphere, requiring players to solve puzzles and engage in occasional turn-based battles.

gameplay: Digital board game and "Pictionary" style quiz.
objetivo: Be the first to collect one card from each of the four categories.
descripcion_corta: Nintendo's first "video board game" focused on social play.
descripcion_larga: Players or AI compete to identify a drawing as it is being sketched on the screen. The faster you guess, the more spaces you move. It features several difficulty levels and categories like "Leisure," "Science," and "Whatchamacallit."

gameplay: Digital board game and "Pictionary" style quiz.
objetivo: Identify drawings as they are sketched to win cards and move.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the puzzle-board game hybrid.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it supports up to four players using controllers. The game is known for its catchy but repetitive soundtrack and the increasing difficulty of the drawings as players progress through the levels.

objetivo: Conquer the known world by managing a vast empire and its military.
descripcion_corta: A deep strategy game from Koei's "Historical Simulation" series.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as Genghis Khan II, this title tasks players with managing resources, diplomacy, and turn-based tactical battles. Players must balance the needs of their citizens while expanding their territory through Eurasia.

objetivo: Unite the Mongol tribes and expand your empire across the world.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in Koei's Genghis Khan strategy series.
descripcion_larga: Set in the 12th century, players take the role of Temujin. The game is divided into two phases: uniting the Mongol tribes and then conquering the rest of the world. It features complex systems for labor, food, and military drafting.

nombre: America Oudan Ultra Quiz - Shijou Saidai no Tatakai (Japan)
objetivo: Save the princess and defeat the demon king to restore peace to Arabia.
descripcion_corta: A unique Middle Eastern-themed RPG known as The Magic of Scheherazade.
descripcion_larga: The game blends real-time overworld exploration with turn-based party combat. Players can travel through time, hire mercenaries, and use "Team Magic" to defeat enemies. It is praised for its unique setting and genre-blending mechanics.

objetivo: Outscore the opponent by any means necessary, including punching.
descripcion_corta: A violent and humorous take on arcade basketball.
descripcion_larga: This is "Basket Brawl" where players can punch opponents to steal the ball. It features a simplified control scheme focusing on dunks, shots, and combat. The European version maintains the fast-paced, irreverent spirit of the arcade original.

nombre: American Dream (Japan) [En by Pale Dim v1.0]
objetivo: Win the game by punching, stealing, and scoring baskets.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Midway's arcade basketball hit.
descripcion_larga: Famous for the tagline "A Basket Brawl," players choose from several characters with unique personalities. The game ignores traditional rules, allowing players to knock down rivals and even pull down their shorts to win the match.

gameplay: Puzzle and strategy with ball physics.
objetivo: Navigate a ball through a maze-like grid to reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: A unique spatial puzzle game with a cold, minimalist aesthetic.
descripcion_larga: Players must move a ball across a tiled grid, interacting with various blocks and mirrors to change direction. The challenge lies in planning the path carefully to reach the exit within the time limit while avoiding falling off the edges.

objetivo: Rescue the penguin's friends while avoiding seals and obstacles.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adventure game featuring slippery movement.
descripcion_larga: This is a port of the MSX game, featuring a penguin that must navigate icy levels. The key mechanic is the momentum-based movement on ice, which makes avoiding enemies like seals and polar bears a challenge of precision and timing.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with a grappling weapon.
objetivo: Defeat the evil Ligar and restore peace to the land of Argool.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the classic known as Rygar.
descripcion_larga: Players control a warrior armed with the Diskarmor, a shield on a chain. Unlike the arcade version, this NES/Famicom port features an interconnected world with RPG elements, where players must find five Indora gods to gain power-ups.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with ground and air attacks.
objetivo: Destroy the enemy mechanical base at the end of each stage.
descripcion_corta: A classic vertical shooter featuring a landing mechanic.
descripcion_larga: Players pilot a futuristic jet that can fire at air targets and drop bombs on ground enemies. A unique feature of this game is the ability to land on specific platforms to upgrade weapons and recover energy, adding a layer of strategy to the shooting.

objetivo: Clear all the bricks on the screen to advance to the next level.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the iconic arcade brick-breaker.
descripcion_larga: Players control the Vaus paddle to bounce a ball and destroy various colored bricks. It features power-ups that drop from destroyed blocks, such as lasers, multiple balls, and a widened paddle, culminating in a boss fight against Doh.

nombre: Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika - Genchou Hishi (Japan)
objetivo: Navigate through 33 rounds and defeat the final boss, Doh.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the legendary Arkanoid.
descripcion_larga: This version is identical to the Japanese one in mechanics but was famous for being sold with a special "Vaus" controller for more precise movement. It set the standard for the brick-breaking genre on home consoles.

nombre: Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika - Genghis Khan (Japan)
objetivo: Complete a series of brand-new, highly challenging levels.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive level-hack of the original Arkanoid.
descripcion_larga: Titled "Dimension of Doh," this fan-made modification replaces all the original stages with custom, much more difficult designs. It is intended for players who have already mastered the official levels and want a new challenge.

gameplay: Paddle-based block-breaking action with level editor.
objetivo: Clear refined levels and utilize new power-ups and enemy types.
descripcion_corta: The Japan-exclusive sequel to the original Arkanoid.
descripcion_larga: Known as Arkanoid: Revenge of Doh, this sequel introduces new brick types, multiple paths between levels, and more complex boss encounters. It also famously included a built-in level editor for players to create their own stages.

objetivo: Recover the stolen Elven ring from the Shogun of Darkness.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced overhead adventure starring a female warrior.
descripcion_larga: Players control Arkista through 125 stages of action. The gameplay focuses on using a bow and arrow to defeat enemies and finding power-ups like armor and fire-wands. It is known for its arcade-like speed and high number of levels.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer with a rolling mechanic.
objetivo: Navigate various themed worlds to rescue your kidnapped girlfriend.
descripcion_corta: A creative platformer where the hero can curl into a ball.
descripcion_larga: Players control an armadillo that can roll to move faster and defeat enemies, a mechanic often compared to Sonic the Hedgehog. The game features an overworld map and diverse stages ranging from deserts to space-themed levels.

gameplay: First-person space exploration and turn-based combat.
objetivo: Travel through the "Artelius" dimension to defeat the King of Darkness.
descripcion_corta: A unique hybrid of space flight simulation and traditional RPG.
descripcion_larga: Players navigate through space in a first-person perspective, visiting planets and space stations. The game features a complex plot involving black holes and alternate dimensions, with a combat system that shifts to a menu-based RPG style when encountering enemies.

objetivo: Collect all the puzzle pieces in each world to progress.
descripcion_corta: A colorful and cute platformer starring the Asmik mascot.
descripcion_larga: Players control Asmik-kun as he explores vibrant worlds. The game is known for its non-violent approach, where players often solve puzzles or play mini-games to advance, rather than just fighting enemies. It features a cheerful art style typical of late-era Famicom games.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with armor mechanics.
objetivo: Collect armor parts to build powerful combat suits.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese original of the shooter known as Alpha Mission.
descripcion_larga: This game is famous for its tactical depth. Players collect "Armor" letters that, when combined, grant the ship massive firepower or defensive shields. Success depends on knowing which armor to deploy for specific boss patterns and stage hazards.

objetivo: Rescue Obelix and defeat the Roman legions across Europe.
descripcion_corta: A multi-language licensed game starring the famous Gauls.
descripcion_larga: Based on the beloved comic series, players control Asterix as he travels through various countries occupied by the Romans. The game features high-quality graphics for the NES and focuses on jumping, punching, and using magic potions to clear stages.

objetivo: Drive across a wasteland to find the legendary "Astro Fang."
descripcion_corta: A high-speed action game featuring a transforming car.
descripcion_larga: In a desert world similar to Mad Max, players drive a car equipped with missiles. The gameplay involves high-speed racing while shooting down enemy vehicles and jumping over obstacles. You must manage your fuel and ammo to reach the end of the long highway stages.

objetivo: Navigate the wasteland to find the legendary Super Machine.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the car-combat title Astro Fang.
descripcion_larga: This version provides a complete English translation of the menus and story. It allows players to follow the narrative of the lone driver in a desolate future, making the upgrade system and mission objectives clear to Western players.

objetivo: Collect energy capsules while managing momentum and gravity.
descripcion_corta: A unique shooter where recoil and weight affect movement.
descripcion_larga: Players control Sasa, a boy with a jetpack. The core mechanic is that every shot fired creates recoil that pushes the player in the opposite direction. This makes movement a constant puzzle of physics, as you must balance shooting enemies with staying airborne.

nombre: Arkanoid (USA) [Hack by Dragon Eye Studios v1.0] (~Arkanoid - Dimension of Doh)
gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with magic systems.
objetivo: Destroy the evil wizard Blackhorn and rescue Princess Rosebud.
descripcion_corta: A dark fantasy action game featuring a massive axe weapon.
descripcion_larga: Players control Astyanax as he fights through a dream world. The game features a "power meter" that grows when you don't swing your weapon, allowing for devastating charged attacks. It is well-known for its impressive cinematic cutscenes and large boss sprites.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with magic systems.
objetivo: Traverse the world of Remlia to defeat the dark forces.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the cinematic fantasy action game.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it offers challenging platforming and a variety of magic spells. The player is accompanied by a small fairy named Cutie, who provides support and story context during the adventure's high-quality interstitial scenes.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with RPG elements.
objetivo: Escaped from the castle and defeat the four guardians of Dante.
descripcion_corta: A challenging adventure game based on the SNK arcade classic.
descripcion_larga: Players control Athena through diverse worlds (Forest, Sea, Sky). As she defeats enemies, she can collect various weapons and armor pieces that change her appearance and abilities. The game is notorious for its high difficulty and cryptic power-up system.

gameplay: Fitness-oriented sports simulation using the Power Pad.
objetivo: Complete all five athletic events to improve your fitness score.
descripcion_corta: An early exercise game designed for the NES Power Pad floor mat.
descripcion_larga: Players participate in events like hurdles, animal chase, and dark tunnel. The game requires physical movement on the mat to control the character on screen. It features different modes (Training and University) to test the player's agility and speed.

gameplay: Fitness-oriented sports simulation using the Power Pad.
objetivo: Finish the athletic circuit and reach the highest rank.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the Power Pad fitness title.
descripcion_larga: Similar to the European release, this version was part of the "Family Fun Fitness" series. It focuses on physical activity, challenging players to run and jump in real life to navigate obstacles in the game, making it one of the first "exer-games" for consoles.

objetivo: Navigate through levels while defeating enemies with magic.
descripcion_corta: A modern homebrew/hack that brings Touhou characters to the NES.
descripcion_larga: This is a fan-made title featuring Cirno from the Touhou Project. It uses the mechanics of Atlantis no Nazo but with updated sprites and music. It’s a crossover that blends classic 8-bit frustration with modern "doujin" culture.

objetivo: Explore 100 mysterious zones to find and rescue your master.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and cryptic exploration game.
descripcion_larga: Players control Wynn as he searches for his master in the lost city of Atlantis. The game is famous for its "suicidal" difficulty, hidden warps, and the fact that many zones can only be reached by performing specific, often counter-intuitive, actions.

objetivo: Navigate the zones of Atlantis in this pre-release build.
descripcion_corta: A beta version of the classic and difficult Atlantis no Nazo.
descripcion_larga: This version contains minor differences in level layouts and enemy placement compared to the final retail release. It offers a glimpse into the development process of one of the Famicom's most mysterious and challenging titles.

objetivo: Fly through surreal school-themed levels to defeat waves of enemies.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced shooter similar to Space Harrier with a schoolgirl protagonist.
descripcion_larga: Players control Nokko, a girl who flies through various environments (like space and forests) shooting at bizarre creatures. The game features a 3D mode (using goggles) and is known for its colorful graphics and high-speed action.

objetivo: Help Nokko clear the Academy's stages of strange monsters.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the quirky 3D shooter.
descripcion_larga: This patch translates the menus and ending of Attack Animal Gakuen. It makes the game's lighthearted story and upgrade systems understandable for English-speaking players while retaining the frantic "into-the-screen" shooting gameplay.

nombre: Astro Fang - Super Machine (Japan) [En by Caution v20010704]
objetivo: Stop the evil Dr. Gangrene and his army of mutated tomatoes.
descripcion_corta: A licensed platformer based on the animated series.
descripcion_larga: Players control Chad Finletter as he jumps through city streets and sewers. Chad can shrink to fit into small spaces and must use his jumping ability to squash tomatoes. The European version features the same quirky humor as the show.

objetivo: Navigate through San Francisco to stop the tomato invasion.
descripcion_corta: The North American release based on the Killer Tomatoes cartoon.
descripcion_larga: This version pits the player against various types of mutated vegetables. While the graphics are simple, the game focuses on precise platforming and finding secret areas to gather items needed to progress toward Dr. Gangrene's base.

objetivo: Win the grand final by outscoring opponents in this unique sport.
descripcion_corta: A sports game dedicated to the specific rules of AFL.
descripcion_larga: This title features the unique mechanics of Australian Football, including kicking for goals, handballs, and marks. It allows for up to four players (with a multitap) and includes several fictional teams based on real-world Australian locations.

objetivo: Win Mahjong hands to unlock hidden images.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed, adult-themed Mahjong game for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: This title features standard Riichi Mahjong rules against female AI opponents. Being an unlicensed "AV" (Adult Video) title, the primary draw for players at the time was the reveal of digitized adult images as a reward for winning matches.

gameplay: Hanafuda card game with adult-themed rewards.
objetivo: Defeat opponents in the traditional card game of Koi-Koi.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult version of the classic Japanese Hanafuda card game.
descripcion_larga: Players engage in the traditional flower card game against computer opponents. Success in the card matches leads to the display of adult-oriented graphics, a common trope for unlicensed cartridges found in the Asian market during the 90s.

gameplay: Mahjong simulation with updated graphics and adult content.
objetivo: Win rounds of Mahjong to progress through the "AV" gallery.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the unlicensed adult Mahjong simulation.
descripcion_larga: This version features improved menus and a different set of opponents compared to the first game. The gameplay remains a straightforward implementation of Mahjong, serving primarily as a vehicle for the adult-themed reward system.

objetivo: Outplay AI opponents in Mahjong to clear stages.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Japanese adult mahjong club simulation.
descripcion_larga: Developed for the Famicom without Nintendo's approval, this game targets an adult audience. It features various "club" settings where players must manage their tiles effectively to win and see the hidden reward graphics.

objetivo: Accumulate virtual credits by winning on the slot machines.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult-themed slot machine simulator.
descripcion_larga: This game mimics the mechanics of Japanese Pachi-Slot parlors. Players manage their medals and try to hit "Big Bonus" cycles. Between sessions, adult images are displayed as part of the game's reward structure.

gameplay: Video Poker simulation with adult-themed rewards.
objetivo: Win hands of poker to increase your score and unlock images.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult video poker game.
descripcion_larga: A simple implementation of five-card draw video poker. The player bets credits to win hands (pairs, flushes, etc.), and reaching certain scoring milestones triggers the display of adult-oriented digital art.

gameplay: Simplified soccer simulation with adult imagery.
objetivo: Win soccer matches against opposing teams.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult-themed sports game focusing on soccer.
descripcion_larga: A very basic soccer game where the player controls a team in a simplified match. Unlike standard sports games, the motivation for winning is the "AV" reward system integrated between matches or at the end of the game.

gameplay: Vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with a wing-attachment system.
objetivo: Navigate through 45 stages and destroy the "Goblin" boss.
descripcion_corta: A classic shooter famous for its 26 different wing power-ups.
descripcion_larga: Players pilot a ship that can attach various "Wings" found at the start of levels. These wings grant different abilities, such as wide shots, hammers, or shields. The game is known for its high difficulty and the strategic depth of choosing the right wing for each environment.

gameplay: Puzzle-platformer with a focus on block manipulation.
objetivo: Rearrange blocks to reach the exit of each of the 64 floors.
descripcion_corta: A challenging logic-based puzzle game set in the Tower of Babel.
descripcion_larga: Players control an archeologist who must move and stack blocks to create stairs and paths. The game features complex physics where blocks can fall or be used to crush enemies. It is highly regarded for its deep logic and satisfying "eureka" moments.

nombre: Attack Animal Gakuen (Japan) [En by PentarouZero v1.0] (~Attack Animal Academy)
objetivo: Shoot hazards and enemies to keep the baby safe as he crawls.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Zapper game where you protect a crawling baby.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Color Dreams, players must shoot birds, pits, and falling objects to ensure a baby reaches the end of the stage safely. It is unique for its "escort" style lightgun gameplay and its colorful, albeit unpolished, unlicensed aesthetic.

gameplay: Side-scrolling adventure with puzzle-solving and time travel.
objetivo: Travel between 1955, 1985, and 2015 to find items and fix the timeline.
descripcion_corta: A multi-era adventure based on the second and third movies.
descripcion_larga: Players control Marty McFly across three time periods. The game requires collecting specific items and returning them to their rightful places in time. It features a password system and various mini-games, though it's known for its cryptic puzzles and difficult navigation.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with two-plane movement.
objetivo: Rescue President Ronnie from the evil Dragon Ninja clan.
descripcion_corta: A classic arcade port of the "Bad Dudes" street brawler.
descripcion_larga: As Blade or Striker, players fight through city streets, trucks, and caves. The game features a power-up system for stronger punches and the iconic "I'm bad!" catchphrase. It is a quintessential 8-bit action title where you fight ninjas to save the president.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with two-plane movement.
objetivo: Defeat the Dragon Ninja and his army to save the kidnapped president.
descripcion_corta: The European release of the arcade hit Bad Dudes.
descripcion_larga: Identical in gameplay to the US version, this port brings the intense arcade action to the NES. Players must use jumps, kicks, and collected weapons like nunchucks to defeat waves of enemies and large boss characters at the end of each stage.

objetivo: Win the league championship and defeat the "All-Star" team.
descripcion_corta: A fun and polished baseball game with humorous animations.
descripcion_larga: Known in Japan as Gekitou Stadium, this game is famous for its charming graphics and "girls' team" mode. It features standard baseball mechanics but adds personality with funny player reactions to home runs, strikeouts, and collisions.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with a variety of martial arts moves.
objetivo: Defeat thugs and punks across the city to clear the streets.
descripcion_corta: A unique brawler with a focus on special combat techniques.
descripcion_larga: Originally part of the "Power Glove" line of games, players control Duke Davis. You must learn and execute different moves like the "trip" or "headbutt" to progress. The game is known for its quirky character designs and the specific moves required for different enemies.

gameplay: Horse racing simulation and betting strategy.
objetivo: Manage your funds and place winning bets on horse races.
descripcion_corta: A realistic horse racing and gambling simulation.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on the statistical side of horse racing. Players analyze horse stats, track conditions, and odds to place bets. It aims to provide an authentic "Gate In" experience for fans of the sport and the betting culture in Japan.

gameplay: Variety/Minigame collection based on celebrity impressions.
objetivo: Compete in various challenges to become the best celebrity impersonator.
descripcion_corta: A wacky collection of mini-games themed around Japanese pop culture.
descripcion_larga: Based on a popular TV show concept, players engage in rhythm and timing games to mimic famous Japanese celebrities. It captures the "Star Monomane" (impressionist) craze of the early 90s with exaggerated 8-bit caricatures and humor.

gameplay: Life simulation and board game with a focus on romance.
objetivo: Navigate the "theater of love" to find a partner and succeed in life.
descripcion_corta: A quirky life-sim board game focused on relationships.
descripcion_larga: Players move across a board representing different stages of life, specifically focusing on dating, marriage, and family. It uses humor and random events to simulate the ups and downs of romantic life in a satirical way.

gameplay: Digital board game and life simulation.
objetivo: Live through a virtual life and finish with the most wealth and happiness.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the famous "Bakushou!! Jinsei Gekijou" series.
descripcion_larga: Similar to the "Game of Life," players roll dice to move through childhood, school, and career paths. Random events can change your stats (like Intelligence or Strength), affecting your job prospects and final score in this lighthearted social simulation.

gameplay: Digital board game and life simulation with enhanced features.
objetivo: Succeed in life by making better choices than your opponents.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the popular Famicom life-simulation board game.
descripcion_larga: This version improves upon the original with more detailed events, better graphics, and expanded career paths. It remains a staple of the "party game" genre on the Famicom, designed for multiple players to enjoy the chaotic randomness of life together.

gameplay: Tile-matching puzzle with a gravity mechanic.
objetivo: Clear the board by matching identical tiles in pairs.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese puzzle game with a ball-themed aesthetic.
descripcion_larga: This title is a variation of Shisen-sho or Mahjong solitaire. Players must select matching tiles that can be connected by a line with no more than two turns. It features various layouts and a simplified visual style typical of unlicensed 8-bit puzzle collections.

objetivo: Score more goals than the opponent by blasting the "Plasmorb" into the goal.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed, 3D-perspective sci-fi sports game.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Lucasfilm Games, players pilot a "Rotofoil" craft on a checkered grid. The game features a split-screen view and focuses on rapid movement and quick turns to capture the ball. It is known for its smooth scrolling and early attempt at 3D gameplay.

objetivo: Pop the balloons of all enemy "Oicho" to clear the stage.
descripcion_corta: A legendary arcade-style game where you fly by flapping your arms.
descripcion_larga: Players control a character with two balloons. By tapping the button, you flap to stay airborne. You must collide with enemies from above to pop their balloons while avoiding lightning, giant fish, and other hazards across various phases and a bonus round.

objetivo: Defeat waves of enemies and survive the "Balloon Trip" mode.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese Famicom version of the iconic flight game.
descripcion_larga: This version established the addictive gameplay loop of "flap and pop." Beyond the 2-player battle/co-op mode, it features the "Balloon Trip" mode, a side-scrolling endurance test where players must navigate a sea of sparks to achieve a high score.

objetivo: Eliminate all enemies in the arena to advance to the next phase.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Nintendo's classic arcade flyer.
