descripcion_larga: Identical to the international versions, this game is celebrated for its tight controls and momentum-based physics. It served as the foundation for the flight mechanics later seen in games like Joust and Super Mario Bros. Deluxe.

nombre: Back to the Future Part II & III (USA)
objetivo: Destroy all bouncing bubbles by shooting them with a vertical wire.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed port of the popular "Pang" arcade gameplay.
descripcion_larga: Players move horizontally at the bottom of the screen, firing a vertical harpoon. Large bubbles split into smaller ones when hit until they disappear. It is a simple but faithful clone of the arcade classic, requiring quick reflexes and spatial awareness.

gameplay: Side-scrolling shoot 'em up with exploration elements.
objetivo: Fly through space stages to find and destroy the enemy mothership.
descripcion_corta: A sci-fi shooter featuring a unique energy-management system.
descripcion_larga: Players control a ship that can fly in all directions while the screen scrolls. The game is known for its high difficulty and the need to collect energy items to keep your ship functional. It features diverse planetary surfaces and underground tunnel sections.

gameplay: Grid-based puzzle with digging and item collection.
objetivo: Collect all the snacks and find the exit in each stage.
descripcion_corta: A simple but addictive puzzle game where you play as a mole.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate a screen filled with dirt, rocks, and food. Digging under rocks causes them to fall, which can be used to crush enemies or block paths. The goal is to collect all items while avoiding being trapped or killed by falling debris.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with RPG elements.
objetivo: Travel to the Vegetable Kingdom to recover the stolen treasures.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality, quirky platformer with a food-themed world.
descripcion_larga: Players control the Banana Prince, who uses a shrinking/growing vine to reach high places and attack. The game features shops to upgrade equipment and a quiz-show mechanic. This German version is highly sought after as it was one of the few official releases in the West.

objetivo: Help the Banana Prince save his kingdom from the Great Pepper.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the rare German/Japanese platformer.
descripcion_larga: This translation allows English speakers to enjoy the witty dialogue and the quiz-game sections of this hidden gem. It fully localizes the menus, item names, and the humorous storyline involving the hero's quest to restore his land's stolen artifacts.

gameplay: Golf simulation with swing meter and club selection.
objetivo: Complete the 18 holes of the Pebble Beach course with the lowest score possible.
descripcion_corta: A realistic golf game featuring the world-famous Pebble Beach course.
descripcion_larga: Players must account for wind speed, direction, and terrain elevation. The game features a split-screen view showing both the character's stance and the overhead map of the hole, allowing for strategic planning of every drive and putt.

gameplay: Turn-based grand strategy and tactical combat.
objetivo: Overthrow the corrupt Gao Qiu and unite the outlaw bands of China.
descripcion_corta: A deep Koei strategy game based on the classic novel "Water Margin."
descripcion_larga: Players manage resources, recruit heroes, and engage in hex-based tactical battles. The game is known for its high level of complexity, requiring the player to balance the popularity of their heroes with the strength of their military forces.

objetivo: Help Barbie navigate through her dreams to reach the party.
descripcion_corta: A colorful platformer where Barbie travels through fantasy dream worlds.
descripcion_larga: Players control Barbie through themed stages like Mermaid Land and Soda Shop. She can throw "Z" bubbles to interact with objects and ask animal friends for help. The game focuses on lighthearted exploration and simple environmental puzzles.

objetivo: Explore dream worlds and find the perfect outfit for the big dance.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Barbie platforming adventure.
descripcion_larga: This version features the same gameplay as the European release. Barbie must collect items and avoid obstacles in diverse dreamscapes. It is noted for its high-quality 8-bit graphics and its appeal to the franchise's younger fan base.

objetivo: Navigate the dream worlds to prepare for Barbie's big event.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the Barbie NES game with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This "Rev A" version contains small internal code corrections to improve stability and performance compared to the initial release, while maintaining the same core gameplay mechanics and story.

objetivo: Scan real-world barcodes to generate characters and fight battles.
descripcion_corta: A unique RPG that uses a Barcode Battler device to create heroes.
descripcion_larga: Players use the Barcode Battler II connected to the NES to scan household items. These barcodes are converted into stats for characters and items. The game features a traditional turn-based combat system where your success depends on the "power" of the barcodes you find.

nombre: Ball Story - Jong Yuk Chuen Suet Fa Jong II (China) (Unl)
objetivo: Recover the seven pieces of the Destiny Wand to save the realm.
descripcion_corta: A deep, party-based sequel to the classic Bard's Tale series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring an improved interface for the Famicom, players manage a party of six adventurers. The game introduces larger outdoor areas and more complex dungeons, requiring careful map-making and strategic use of a wide array of spells and combat classes.

objetivo: Assemble a team of heroes to defeat the evil wizard Mangar.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese adaptation of the legendary PC RPG series.
descripcion_larga: This version features updated graphics and a more console-friendly menu system compared to the Western original. It remains a hardcore RPG experience where party management and resource conservation in deep dungeons are key to survival.

objetivo: Defeat Mangar the Dark and free the city of Skara Brae.
descripcion_corta: The official North American console port of the PC classic.
descripcion_larga: A faithful adaptation of the game that helped define the dungeon-crawler genre. Players explore the city and its underworld in a first-person grid view, engaging in turn-based combat and solving cryptic riddles to progress through the story.

objetivo: Hit all targets in each circus-themed act to move to the next level.
descripcion_corta: A colorful and fun Zapper game based on classic carnival tricks.
descripcion_larga: Players must shoot plates, balloons, and other objects launched by Barker Bill. The game features several modes with increasing speed and difficulty, requiring sharp reflexes and accuracy. It is known for its upbeat music and cameos from other Nintendo characters.

objetivo: Recover the three sacred treasures of the Vegetable Kingdom.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the platformer known as Banana Prince.
descripcion_larga: This is the original Japanese release. While the core gameplay remains the same as the German version, it features different quiz questions and some minor graphical variations. It is highly regarded for its tight controls and creative level design.

descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Barbie platforming adventure.
descripcion_larga: Barbie travels through various dreamscapes like Mermaid Land and a 50s-style soda shop. Players use "Z" bubbles to wake up items and solve environmental puzzles. It is noted for its high-quality 8-bit graphics and charm.

descripcion_corta: An updated version of the Barbie NES game with minor bug fixes.

nombre: Bard's Tale II, The - The Destiny Knight (Japan)
objetivo: Recover the seven pieces of the Destiny Wand to save the realm.
descripcion_corta: A deep, party-based sequel to the classic Bard's Tale series.

nombre: Bard's Tale, The - Tales of the Unknown (Japan)
objetivo: Assemble a team of heroes to defeat the evil wizard Mangar.

nombre: Bard's Tale, The - Tales of the Unknown (USA)
objetivo: Defeat Mangar the Dark and free the city of Skara Brae.
descripcion_corta: The official North American console port of the PC classic.

descripcion_larga: Players must shoot plates, balloons, and other objects launched by Barker Bill. The game features several modes with increasing speed and difficulty, requiring sharp reflexes. It includes cameos from other Nintendo characters.

objetivo: Score enough points to progress through the circus acts.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Barker Bill's Zapper game.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it offers four different types of target shooting mini-games. It is one of the few games that truly utilizes the Zapper's accuracy for fast-paced, arcade-style shooting galleries.

objetivo: Win the Cyber Stadium championship by outscoring or outfighting rivals.
descripcion_corta: A unique sports game where robots play baseball and fight.
descripcion_larga: Players control teams of robots. If a play is close, a fighting mini-game occurs; destroying the opponent's robot counts as an "out." Players can buy parts to upgrade their robots' armor, speed, and weaponry.

gameplay: Sports simulation focusing on fundamental baseball.
objetivo: Outscore the AI or a second player in a 9-inning game.
descripcion_corta: The earliest baseball title for the Famicom/NES.
descripcion_larga: Part of the original "Sports Series," it features simple pitching and batting mechanics. While basic by modern standards, it set the foundation for the genre on consoles, allowing for 2-player competitive matches.

objetivo: Outscore the opponent over nine innings of play.
descripcion_corta: The international release of Nintendo's classic launch-title baseball game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring simple controls and iconic 8-bit sprites, this version focuses on the core mechanics of pitching, batting, and base running. It is a faithful port of the Japanese original and one of the best-selling early sports titles for the system.

objetivo: Win the league championship and develop your team's skills.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy baseball game with unique character designs.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast-paced gameplay and vibrant graphics, this title emphasizes the competitive spirit of Japanese professional baseball. It features a variety of teams and allows players to manage rosters to a limited degree during the season.

gameplay: Baseball simulation with deep customization and "Ultra" moves.
objetivo: Create a custom team and win the World Series.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive baseball sim known for its "Ultra Plays" and stat tracking.
descripcion_larga: Known in Japan as Choujin Ultra Baseball, this game allows players to use supernatural powers like exploding pitches or meteor hits. It also features a deep editing mode where players can create teams, edit names, and track full-season statistics.

objetivo: Guide your team from the bottom to the top of the league.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese precursor to the famous Baseball Stars series.
descripcion_larga: Developed by SNK, this game introduced the ability to earn money from games to hire better players or upgrade existing ones. It blends sports action with a sense of progression usually found in RPGs, making it highly addictive.

gameplay: Baseball simulation with RPG-style team management.
objetivo: Build a powerhouse team by winning games and hiring stars.
descripcion_corta: A revolutionary sports title featuring battery backup for saving stats.
descripcion_larga: This game is legendary for being one of the first to allow players to create their own teams and players. As you win games, you earn money to upgrade player attributes, making it one of the deepest and most beloved sports games on the NES.

objetivo: Lead your chosen team to the championship in a competitive league.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the SNK classic, focusing on refined graphics and speed.
descripcion_larga: While it removed the team creation feature of the first game, it greatly improved the visual presentation and animations. The gameplay is faster, the sprites are larger, and it offers a more "arcade-perfect" feel compared to its predecessor.

gameplay: Realistic baseball simulation with a TV-style perspective.
objetivo: Win the pennant by defeating all other teams in the league.
descripcion_corta: A popular sports game known for its unique behind-the-pitcher camera.
descripcion_larga: This "Rev A" version fixed minor bugs from the initial release. It was famous for using real-life player stats (though not licensed names) and a perspective that mimicked a television broadcast, providing a more immersive experience for fans.

gameplay: Baseball simulation with a focus on perfection and skill.
objetivo: Defeat the "perfect" team to prove your mastery.
descripcion_corta: The third installment in the Bases Loaded series by Jaleco.
descripcion_larga: This entry shifted focus toward a "rating" system where players are graded on their performance. To beat the game, you don't just have to win; you have to play a perfect game against a highly skilled computer-controlled team.

gameplay: Traditional baseball simulation with updated rosters.
objetivo: Win the league championship against increasingly difficult AI.
descripcion_corta: The final entry of the Bases Loaded series on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Released late in the console's life, it features the most refined graphics and AI of the series. It returned to a more traditional season structure while maintaining the signature behind-the-pitcher viewpoint and detailed player stats.

gameplay: Multi-team baseball simulation with expanded stats.
objetivo: Navigate a full 132-game season to win the championship.
descripcion_corta: The direct sequel to the original Bases Loaded hit.
descripcion_larga: Often considered one of the best in the series, it introduced a faster game speed and a more detailed "biorhythm" system that affects player performance based on the day. It features 12 teams divided into two Western-style divisions.

objetivo: Defeat alien "Morphoids" and clear each stage within the time limit.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype featuring a shape-shifting protagonist.
descripcion_larga: Players control a character who can transform into different forms to overcome obstacles and enemies. As a prototype, it shows a unique concept that was never officially published, featuring fast-paced action and experimental level designs.

objetivo: Pursue and defeat the Joker to prevent him from destroying Gotham.
descripcion_corta: The European version of the visually stunning Batman sequel.
descripcion_larga: Known for pushing the NES hardware to its limits, this game features massive sprites and detailed backgrounds. Batman uses his "Sonic Neutralizer" to fire various projectile types (Power, Blitz, Twin, etc.) in a more shooting-oriented style than the first game.

objetivo: Track down the Joker and his high-tech army across industrial stages.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Return of the Joker.
descripcion_larga: Often praised for its "16-bit" quality graphics on 8-bit hardware, it features complex boss fights and a weapon upgrade system. Players must manage their energy to fire powerful charged shots and navigate through side-scrolling and flying stages.

objetivo: Fight through the streets of Gotham to face the Joker at the Cathedral.
descripcion_corta: The official European release based on the 1989 Tim Burton film.
descripcion_larga: Widely considered one of the best NES games, it features tight controls and a distinctive wall-jump mechanic. Batman uses punches and three sub-weapons (Batarang, Dirks, and Bat-Disk) to navigate stages inspired by the movie's dark aesthetic.

objetivo: Navigate 5 stages to stop the Joker's plot in Gotham City.
descripcion_corta: The legendary Sunsoft action game based on the Batman movie.
descripcion_larga: Renowned for its atmospheric music and cinematic cutscenes, this version follows Batman through iconic locations like the Axis Chemical Factory. The game is famous for its high difficulty, particularly the final climb to the Joker.

objetivo: Test the levels and mechanics of the Caped Crusader's adventure.
descripcion_corta: A beta build of the first Batman game by Sunsoft.
descripcion_larga: This version contains minor differences in enemy placement and level assets compared to the final release. It offers a fascinating look at the development process and balancing of what would become a classic 8-bit title.

nombre: Batman - The Video Game (USA) [Hack by Deespence2929 v1.0] (~Batman - Easy)
objetivo: Experience the classic Batman game with reduced difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made hack designed to make the game more accessible.
descripcion_larga: This modification typically increases Batman's health, provides more sub-weapon ammunition, or reduces enemy damage. It is intended for players who find the original Sunsoft difficulty curve too steep but want to experience the story and levels.

objetivo: Defeat the criminals of Gotham and stop the Joker.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the Sunsoft Batman classic.
descripcion_larga: While identical in gameplay to the US/EU versions, it features the original Japanese text and slightly different branding. It remains a showcase of Sunsoft's technical mastery of the Famicom's sound and graphics chips.

objetivo: Play with a friend in a custom co-op mode.
descripcion_corta: A modern romhack that adds 2-player simultaneous play to Batman.
descripcion_larga: This impressive technical feat allows two players to control Batman and a partner (often recolored) simultaneously through the original levels. It adjusts the mechanics to ensure both players can navigate the screen together.

objetivo: Stop the Penguin and Catwoman from taking over Gotham City.
descripcion_corta: A late-release brawler based on the second Batman movie.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, this game features large, detailed sprites and focus on hand-to-hand combat. It includes both traditional side-scrolling fighting stages and vehicle-based levels featuring the Batmobile, making it a diverse action experience.

objetivo: Defeat the Penguin and Catwoman to save Gotham's Christmas.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of Konami's Batman sequel.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Sunsoft games, this is a pure brawler. Batman can grab and throw enemies against walls or each other. It features impressive graphics and sound for the NES, and includes iconic stages like the Batmobile chase and the showdown at the Arctic World.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with character swapping.
objetivo: Defeat rival gang members across various urban stages.
descripcion_corta: An action game based on a popular Japanese high school baseball manga.
descripcion_larga: Players can switch between the two protagonists, Batsu and Terry. Although based on a baseball manga, it’s an action game where they use baseball-themed attacks (like hitting balls) to fight enemies. It features branching paths and a unique "map" system.

objetivo: Win the tournament using a team of robots and anime-style heroes.
descripcion_corta: A wacky baseball game featuring Banpresto's crossover characters.
descripcion_larga: This title features iconic characters from Gundam, Ultraman, and Kamen Rider playing baseball. Each team has special "super moves" and stats, making it a "Compati Hero" sports spin-off that focuses more on fun and fanservice than realism.

objetivo: Checkmate the opponent's King in a fantasy-themed chess game.
descripcion_corta: A version of chess where the pieces come to life and fight.
descripcion_larga: Based on the famous computer game, the chess pieces are animated characters. When a capture occurs, the game shows a brief battle animation. It includes various AI difficulty levels and the option for 2-player matches with a unique fantasy aesthetic.

objetivo: Protect your eagle base and destroy all 20 enemy tanks per stage.
descripcion_corta: Namco's classic tank combat game, a staple of Famicom bootlegs.
descripcion_larga: Players control a tank on a grid of bricks, bushes, and water. You can shoot through walls and collect power-ups like shovels (to reinforce the base) or stars (to upgrade your tank's fire rate and armor). It is famous for its "Construction Mode" level editor.

nombre: Battle City (Japan) [Hack by AnS v0.999] (~Binary City)
objetivo: Navigate complex new levels in this technical modification.
descripcion_corta: An advanced hack of Battle City with modified physics and levels.
descripcion_larga: Also known as Binary City, this hack introduces new level designs and sometimes alters the enemy AI or projectile speed. It is aimed at fans of the original who want a fresh, more difficult challenge using the classic engine.

objetivo: Defend the base with up to three friends simultaneously.
descripcion_corta: A modern technical hack that enables 4-player gameplay.
descripcion_larga: This impressive mod allows four players to play at once (using a Four-Score or similar adapter). The levels are often adjusted to accommodate more tanks on screen, turning the classic defensive shooter into a chaotic multiplayer experience.

objetivo: Command a fleet to win naval battles through tactical positioning.
descripcion_corta: A strategy game focused on Pacific-style naval warfare.
descripcion_larga: Players manage a fleet of ships, including carriers and battleships. The game requires careful planning of movement and firing arcs. It features a split-screen view for combat animations and is one of the more technical military sims on the Famicom.

objetivo: Race through futuristic highways while shooting down enemy vehicles.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically impressive racers/shooters on the system.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as 8 Eyes (erroneously) or more correctly related to Super Spy Hunter, it features incredible scrolling and parallax effects. Players drive a transforming car-boat-plane, using missiles and shields to survive a relentless mechanical army.

objetivo: Travel across ancient Greece to rescue your lover, Helena, from Hades.
descripcion_corta: A deep, Greek mythology-themed adventure similar to Zelda II.
descripcion_larga: Players visit famous cities like Athens and Crete, gaining weapons and items from Olympian gods. It features a non-linear world, a password system, and challenging combat. It is highly praised for its atmosphere, music, and faithful mythological references.

objetivo: Rescue your beloved Helene from the clutches of Hades.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the epic Greek mythology adventure.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, players explore ancient Greece in a non-linear fashion. By gathering items like the Harp of Apollo or the Sandals of Hermes, you gain access to new areas. It is widely considered a "hidden gem" for its depth and atmosphere.

objetivo: Win the Koshien-style tournament with your chosen baseball team.
descripcion_corta: A quirky, arcade-style baseball game featuring cute characters.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on the high school baseball tournament craze in Japan. It features fast-paced pitching and batting with a focus on fun, featuring specialized animations for home runs and strikeouts with a distinct "chibi" art style.

objetivo: Destroy the enemy's headquarters while defending your own.
descripcion_corta: A strategic tank shooter with a focus on base defense.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the arcade style of Battle City, this game leans more into tactical movement. Players must manage their units across a map, utilizing terrain and power-ups to outmaneuver the enemy AI in a series of increasingly difficult missions.

objetivo: Sink all of the opponent's hidden ships before they sink yours.
descripcion_corta: A digital adaptation of the classic Milton Bradley board game.
descripcion_larga: This version includes a "Super" mode where players can use special weapons and different types of radar. The European release features multiple languages and detailed animations of the missiles firing and ships exploding in a cinematic split-screen.

objetivo: Guess the coordinates of the enemy fleet to achieve total victory.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the strategic naval combat game.
descripcion_larga: It brings the classic "hit or miss" gameplay to the NES. It features both a traditional mode that mimics the board game and an action-oriented mode with power-ups and varied mission objectives, providing more depth than the physical version.

objetivo: Complete 10 dangerous missions in a futuristic war zone.
descripcion_corta: A cockpit-view tank shooter focused on mission objectives.
descripcion_larga: Players pilot the "Battletank" from a first-person perspective. The gameplay involves using a radar to track enemies and switching between different weapon types (shells, missiles, and machine guns) to destroy tanks, helicopters, and bunkers.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up and multi-genre action.
objetivo: Rescue Pimple and Princess Angelica from the Dark Queen.
descripcion_corta: The European version of the notoriously difficult action classic.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Rare, this game is a technical marvel. It features "Turbo Tunnel" speeder bike levels, rappelling down pits, and traditional brawling. It is famous for its punishing difficulty and high-quality animations and music.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up and multi-genre action.
objetivo: Defeat the Dark Queen's forces across 12 diverse stages.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the legendary Battletoads.
descripcion_larga: While the gameplay remains largely the same, this version is notable for being slightly easier than the US release (specifically in the speeder bike and "Volkmire's Inferno" levels) to better suit the Japanese market's preference at the time.

gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up and multi-genre action.
objetivo: Survive the ultimate challenge and defeat the Dark Queen.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the iconic and brutal Battletoads.
descripcion_larga: Known for its intense difficulty and creative level design, it pushes the NES hardware with pseudo-3D effects and massive boss sprites. It remains a staple of 8-bit gaming history, testing the reflexes and patience of even the best players.

objetivo: Stop the alliance between the Dark Queen and the Shadow Boss.
descripcion_corta: An epic crossover between the Battletoads and Double Dragon series.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose from three Toads or two Dragons (Billy and Jimmy Lee). The game combines the mechanics of both franchises, allowing for 2-player simultaneous play. It features space-shooter stages and intense brawling across the spaceship Ratship.

nombre: Battletoads & Double Dragon - The Ultimate Team (Europe)
objetivo: Defeat the alliance of the Dark Queen and the Shadow Warriors.
descripcion_corta: The European release of the ultimate 8-bit action crossover.
descripcion_larga: Featuring characters from both franchises, players choose between the Toads or the Lee brothers. The game is famous for its large sprites, improved 2-player cooperative mechanics, and a variety of stages including brawling, space shooting, and 3D-perspective climbing.

nombre: Battletoads & Double Dragon - The Ultimate Team (USA)
objetivo: Journey to the Colossus spaceship to stop the ultimate evil team.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the Toads and Dragons team-up.
descripcion_larga: This version is identical to the European one, providing a slightly more balanced difficulty curve than the original Battletoads. It is highly regarded for its catchy soundtrack and the fun of using Battletoads' "smash" attacks on Double Dragon's classic enemies.

objetivo: Complete the game with modified character palettes.
descripcion_corta: A visual modification of the original Battletoads.
descripcion_larga: This is a simple cosmetic hack that alters the colors of the protagonist Toads (Rash, Zitz, and Pimple). While the core gameplay and extreme difficulty remain unchanged, it offers a fresh aesthetic for long-time fans of the series.

gameplay: Top-down vehicular combat and maze navigation.
objetivo: Collect all items in the maze while avoiding or crashing into enemy cars.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed car combat game similar to Rally-X.
descripcion_larga: Players control a small car in a large maze, trying to clear stages by collecting points. The game features simple graphics and was commonly found on multi-carts in the 90s. It focuses on quick turns and using "smoke" or projectiles to stop pursuing vehicles.

objetivo: Navigate the tough life of a high school delinquent to gain respect.
descripcion_corta: An adventure game based on the popular manga and anime.
descripcion_larga: Players control the duo Hiroshi and Toru through a series of dialogue choices and exploration. The game captures the 80s Japanese delinquent culture, featuring school rivalries, street fights (in RPG style), and humorous interactions with various characters.

objetivo: Guide the Beast through the castle and forest to break the curse.
descripcion_corta: A European-exclusive Disney license with high-quality visuals.
descripcion_larga: Based on the animated classic, players control the Beast. He can punch, jump, and climb walls. The game is surprisingly dark and difficult, requiring precise platforming to protect the castle from Belle's villagers and Gaston's final assault.

objetivo: Collect nectar from flowers and return it to the hive.
descripcion_corta: A unique unlicensed game starring a bee with big eyes.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Codemasters, players control Bee 52 through garden environments. You must sting enemies and navigate spider webs to collect enough nectar. It features a distinct visual style and physics-based flying that makes it stand out from typical shooters.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with puzzle elements.
objetivo: Help Beetlejuice scare the "Deetzes" out of their new home.
descripcion_corta: A platformer based on the Beetlejuice animated series.
descripcion_larga: Players control the "Ghost with the Most" through various spooky levels. You can buy "scares" (power-ups) from a shop and must use specific tricks to defeat bosses. It is known for its strange physics and high difficulty in the later levels.

gameplay: Horse racing management and breeding simulation.
objetivo: Breed and train a champion horse to win the Japan Derby.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the long-running Derby Stallion franchise.
descripcion_larga: This game focuses heavily on the simulation aspect of horse racing. Players manage stables, choose bloodlines for breeding, and decide on training regimens. It was a massive hit in Japan, starting a craze for statistical sports simulations on consoles.

objetivo: Manage your stable and win prestigious races in Japan.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the original Derby Stallion with bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This "Rev A" version contains minor technical improvements and potentially rebalanced horse stats from the initial release. The core gameplay remains the same deep, menu-driven management experience that rewards patience and strategic planning.

nombre: Best of the Best - Championship Karate (Europe)
objetivo: Train your fighter and win the Kumite world championship.
descripcion_corta: A realistic kickboxing/karate simulator with deep customization.
descripcion_larga: Players can customize their fighter's moveset from a variety of kicks and punches. The game focuses on technical combat, requiring precise timing for blocks and counters. It features a training mode to build stats before entering the main tournament.

nombre: Best of the Best - Championship Karate (USA)
objetivo: Rise through the ranks of the international karate circuit.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the technical fighter Best of the Best.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it is known for its fluid character animations (for the era) and a focus on realism over arcade action. Players must manage their stamina and health carefully during the grueling 3-round matches.

objetivo: Manage a professional team to win the 1990 season championship.
descripcion_corta: A data-heavy baseball sim focused on coaching and management.
descripcion_larga: This update to the series features the full 1990 Japanese league rosters. Players do not control the athletes directly during games; instead, you act as the manager, making tactical substitutions and strategic calls based on detailed player statistics.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory through strategic roster management.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the acclaimed Best Play Pro Yakyuu series.
descripcion_larga: A pioneer in the "manager-only" sports genre on the Famicom. It emphasizes simulation over action, allowing players to edit teams and track extensive stats throughout a full season. It was highly successful in Japan for its strategic depth.

objetivo: Guide your team to the pennant with updated management tools.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the original baseball management sim.
descripcion_larga: This "Rev A" version contains minor technical refinements and bug fixes over the initial release, ensuring more stable simulation results and smoother menu navigation for the player-manager.

objetivo: Outsmart rival managers to win the league title.
descripcion_corta: The second major installment in the management-focused series.
descripcion_larga: This sequel expanded on the original's formula with improved AI and more detailed player data. It allowed for deeper customization of team strategies, such as setting specific player tendencies for batting and pitching.

objetivo: Compete in a specialized league with advanced stat tracking.
descripcion_corta: A special edition of the series with refined simulation engines.
descripcion_larga: This "Special" version features enhanced data management and potentially new team configurations. It remains focused on the "armchair manager" experience, where victory is earned in the dugout through spreadsheets and tactical decisions.

objetivo: Complete three stories: Noah's Ark, Baby Moses, and David and Goliath.
descripcion_corta: A well-known religious-themed multi-game by Wisdom Tree.
descripcion_larga: Players pick one of three adventures. The gameplay mostly involves picking up and carrying objects (or animals) to a goal. It is famous for its unique "stacking" mechanic where Noah can carry multiple animals at once to his ark.

objetivo: Navigate biblical challenges to complete the missions.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the unlicensed Bible Adventures.
descripcion_larga: This version features minor graphical tweaks and bug fixes from the initial release. The gameplay remains the same, focusing on non-violent tasks like rescuing animals or protecting baby Moses from Egyptian guards.

objetivo: Carry out divine tasks across three different game modes.
descripcion_corta: The final refined version of the Wisdom Tree classic.
descripcion_larga: Version 1.2 is the most stable release of the game, fixing several glitches found in the early unlicensed cartridges. It retains the signature gameplay of lifting and throwing objects to solve simple environmental puzzles.

objetivo: Complete the three biblical quests: Noah, Moses, and David.
descripcion_corta: The final technical revision of the religious multi-game.
descripcion_larga: This unlicensed version 1.3 is the most polished iteration by Wisdom Tree. It features the same "lifting and carrying" mechanics across three different stories, with further minor bug fixes to ensure the game doesn't crash on newer NES clones.

objetivo: Navigate a food-themed board to reach the end of the buffet.
descripcion_corta: A quirky, unlicensed party game based on food and health.
descripcion_larga: Players roll dice to move across a board. Landing on certain spaces triggers top-down action mini-games where you must collect good food and avoid junk food. Version 6.0 is the standard stable release for this unique, non-violent title.

objetivo: Rescue your tribe and defeat the evil Witchdoctor.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype of the second Big Nose adventure.
descripcion_larga: This prototype shows an early version of the prehistoric platformer. Players control Big Nose as he jumps through islands and uses stones to defeat enemies. It features different level layouts and music compared to the final "Freaks Out" release.

objetivo: Recover your stolen gold from the prehistoric thief.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced unlicensed sequel featuring a caveman on a board.
descripcion_larga: Big Nose now moves on a primitive skateboard, adding a momentum-based feel to the platforming. The game is known for its high speed, colorful graphics, and the ability to use a club and stones to defeat enemies while navigating large levels.

objetivo: Find your dinner by chasing a pterodactyl across several islands.
descripcion_corta: A prehistoric adventure featuring a hungry caveman.
descripcion_larga: Big Nose travels through four islands (Paradise, Monster, etc.). Players can collect bones to buy power-ups in shops. It is a solid platformer for the NES, despite being an unlicensed release by the company Camerica.

gameplay: Monster truck racing and car-crushing events.
objetivo: Win the truck championship by completing races and challenges.
descripcion_corta: A licensed monster truck game featuring the famous Bigfoot.
descripcion_larga: Players compete in side-scrolling races against rival trucks and participate in "car crushing" events. Between levels, you must manage your budget to repair and upgrade the truck's engine, tires, and suspension.

gameplay: Monster truck racing and car-crushing events.
objetivo: Defeat the "Blackbeard" truck and win the Bigfoot trophy.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the monster truck simulation.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it offers a mix of arcade racing and light management. It features a unique "cockpit" view during certain segments and requires careful driving to avoid flipping the truck on rough terrain.

nombre: Bikkuri Nekketsu Shin Kiroku! - Harukanaru Kin Medal (Japan)
objetivo: Win the gold medal in five unique and violent Olympic events.
descripcion_corta: A wacky sports entry in the Nekketsu (Kunio-kun) series.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as Crash 'n' the Boys: Street Challenge, this game features bizarre events like "Hammer Throw Golf" and "Building Pole Vault." Players can use physical attacks to hinder opponents, staying true to the Nekketsu spirit.

objetivo: Help the Bikkuriman heroes defeat the devil forces.
descripcion_corta: An RPG based on the popular Japanese sticker and anime franchise.
descripcion_larga: Players explore a top-down world and engage in battles that use a card-based system for attacks and defenses. It features many characters from the Bikkuriman universe and is known for its bright, anime-accurate 8-bit art style.

nombre: Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Adventure (USA)
gameplay: Adventure with mini-games and time travel.
objetivo: Find the historical figures and return them to the future.
descripcion_corta: A non-linear adventure based on the cult classic movie.
descripcion_larga: Players control Bill and Ted as they travel to different time periods (Western, Medieval, etc.). You must talk to NPCs, find specific items, and avoid "historical" hazards to progress. It is known for its confusing navigation and top-down exploration.

objetivo: Win the NASCAR championship by placing first in high-speed oval races.
descripcion_corta: An early NASCAR racing sim endorsed by champion Bill Elliott.
descripcion_larga: Players can customize their car's spoiler, tires, and gear ratios. The game features a cockpit view and focuses on the strategy of drafting and managing pit stops during long races on authentic tracks like Daytona and Talladega.

objetivo: Guide two penguins to meet at the top-center heart simultaneously.
descripcion_corta: A charming puzzle game where you control two characters at once.
descripcion_larga: Players control Gurin and Malon. The catch is that they move in mirror-image to each other; when you press left, one moves left and the other moves right. You must navigate spider webs and enemies to make them meet at the exit at the exact same time.

objetivo: Match the numbers on your card to win virtual credits.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Bingo game released for the Asian Famicom market.
descripcion_larga: A straightforward implementation of the 75-ball bingo game. Players manage multiple cards and watch as numbers are drawn randomly. It features basic graphics and was typically found on gambling-focused multi-carts.

objetivo: Complete a line or pattern on your bingo card to win.
descripcion_corta: The NES-pin version of the unlicensed Bingo 75 game.
descripcion_larga: Identical in gameplay to the Famicom version, this title provides a digital bingo experience. It is designed for quick sessions of luck-based play, featuring automated number marking and a simple interface.

objetivo: Use professional wrestling moves to defeat a terrorist organization.
descripcion_corta: A legendary lost prototype featuring a genetically enhanced ape.
descripcion_larga: Long considered "vaporware," this prototype was eventually found. It features an ape with incredible speed and agility who can perform wrestling slams on enemies. It is known for its frantic pace and bizarre, high-energy cutscenes.

objetivo: Save the kingdom from the demon Zauras using a magical rattle.
descripcion_corta: A unique Konami platformer starring a heroic baby.
descripcion_larga: Players control Upa, a prince who can inflate enemies with his rattle, turning them into floating platforms. The game features creative levels (like a world made of cake) and the signature high-quality music and polish associated with Konami's 8-bit era.

nombre: Bio Miracle Bokutte Upa (Japan) [En by Vice v1.0] (~Bio Miracle Baby Upa!!)
objetivo: Defeat the demon Zauras and restore peace to the Baby Kingdom.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of Konami's charming baby-themed platformer.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the story and menus accessible to English speakers. It retains all the original gameplay mechanics, including Upa’s ability to "dig" through certain materials and use inflated enemies to reach secret areas.

nombre: Bio Senshi Dan - Increaser Tono Tatakai (Japan)
objetivo: Destroy the "Increasers" before they take over the Earth.
descripcion_corta: A dark sci-fi action game with a focus on biological threats.
descripcion_larga: Players control Dan, a warrior who must navigate mazes and destroy alien organisms. The game features a unique timer system where enemies grow stronger as time passes, requiring a balance between careful exploration and speed.

nombre: Bio Senshi Dan - Increaser Tono Tatakai (Japan) [En by Abstract Crouton v1.5] (~Bio-Warrior Dan - The Inkliezar Battle)
objetivo: Eradicate the Increaser menace in this sci-fi adventure.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of the biological-horror action title.
descripcion_larga: This localization allows players to understand the mission objectives and the "Increaser" growth mechanics. The game is praised for its atmosphere, boss designs, and the urgency created by the evolving enemy threat.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with a grappling hook.
objetivo: Infiltrate the Imperial army's base to stop the "Albatross" project.
descripcion_corta: A classic action game that replaces jumping with a bionic arm.
descripcion_larga: Players control Ladd Spencer, who uses a grappling hook to swing across pits and climb platforms. This unique mechanic defines the gameplay, as the player cannot jump. It is famous for its complex level design, catchy music, and iconic ending.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action platformer with grappling hook.
objetivo: Rescue Super Joe and stop the Badds' secret "Albatross" weapon.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the iconic swinging action game.
descripcion_larga: Known for its lack of a jump button, players must master the bionic arm to swing and climb. This version famously changed the original Japanese "Nazi" references to "Badds" and "Generalissimo Kill," though it retained the iconic and graphic ending sequence.

nombre: Bionic Commando (USA) [Hack by Chris Covell v0.99] (Uncensored Edition)
objetivo: Defeat the Neo-Nazis and stop the resurrection of Adolf Hitler.
descripcion_corta: A fan-restoration that brings back the original Japanese content.
descripcion_larga: This hack reverts the localization changes made by Nintendo of America. It restores Swastikas, the "Imperial Army" name, and the original identity of the final boss, allowing players to experience the game as it was originally intended in Japan.

objetivo: Feed your chicks enough butterflies to help them grow and migrate.
descripcion_corta: A simple and unique game where you play as a mother bird.
descripcion_larga: Players control a bird flying through a forest, catching insects to feed hungry chicks in a nest. You must avoid predators like hawks and cats. The game is divided into seasons, with different environmental challenges in each level.

gameplay: Fishing simulation with career and tournament modes.
objetivo: Catch the biggest bass in various lakes to win the tournament.
descripcion_corta: The second entry in the popular Famicom fishing series.
descripcion_larga: This sequel improved the graphics and added more depth to the lure selection and fish behavior. It features a top-down view for navigating the lake and a side-view "underwater" perspective once a fish is hooked, requiring careful line tension management.

objetivo: Rise through the ranks of the professional bass fishing circuit.
descripcion_corta: The localized North American version of the Black Bass series.
descripcion_larga: Players choose their equipment, time of day, and location on the lake. It is praised for its realistic (for the time) simulation of bass behavior, where factors like water temperature and lure type determine your success in catching "The Big One."

objetivo: Win the local fishing tournament by catching the heaviest total weight.
descripcion_corta: The first official "Black Bass" title for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: This game established the series' formula: selecting a spot on a map, choosing a lure, and engaging in a "battle" with the fish once it bites. It was one of the first games to make fishing a competitive and strategic experience on consoles.

objetivo: Beat the dealer's hand without exceeding 21 to win credits.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Blackjack game developed by SEI.
descripcion_larga: A straightforward implementation of the classic casino game. Players can split, double down, and take insurance. Like many unlicensed titles, it features a simple interface and was often part of gambling-themed multicarts.

gameplay: Arcade-style ice hockey with fighting mechanics.
objetivo: Outscore the opposing team to win the tournament.
descripcion_corta: The European release of Konami's classic hockey title.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast gameplay and the ability to engage in fistfights between players. If a fight occurs, the loser is sent to the penalty box. It features a distinctive voice-synthesized "Blades of Steel!" at the title screen and a fun mini-game during intermission.

gameplay: Arcade-style ice hockey with fighting mechanics.
objetivo: Lead your team to victory in the Cup tournament.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of Konami's hit hockey game.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the international versions, it remains one of the most beloved sports games on the NES. It features smooth scrolling, responsive controls, and the iconic "face-off" mechanic, offering a perfect blend of sports simulation and arcade fun.

objetivo: Explore the underworld and destroy the Plutonium Boss.
descripcion_corta: A technical masterpiece featuring a jumping combat tank.
descripcion_larga: Players control Jason and his tank, SOPHIA, in side-scrolling stages. Jason can exit the tank to explore interiors in a top-down perspective. This version is known for its incredible music and the "grenade glitch" that helped players defeat difficult bosses.

objetivo: Rescue your pet frog Fred and defeat the radioactive mutants.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the iconic tank-adventure game.
descripcion_larga: As Jason, you pilot the SOPHIA III tank through 8 massive, interconnected areas. The game seamlessly transitions from vehicle platforming to top-down dungeon exploration when Jason exits the tank. It is legendary for its tight controls, epic boss fights, and incredible soundtrack.

objetivo: Slide tiles to create a path for a ball or character to reach the exit.
descripcion_corta: A puzzle game based on the "Blodia" (Timegate) mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Similar to games like Pipe Dream, you must quickly rearrange floor tiles to guide a moving object. It features various themed worlds and increasing speed, requiring fast thinking and spatial awareness to avoid crashing into dead ends.

gameplay: Turn-based RPG with an oriental fantasy theme.
objetivo: Defeat the evil god Shan-Go and his army of warriors.
descripcion_corta: A post-apocalyptic RPG set in a world inspired by Asian mythology.
descripcion_larga: Published by Toei Animation, this game features a traditional party-based structure. It stands out for its dark, gritty atmosphere and a combat system that includes a variety of special techniques and spells, reflecting the classic "hardcore" Famicom RPG era.

objetivo: Navigate through levels to reach the end of the quest.
descripcion_corta: A simple, unlicensed platformer featuring a blue blob.
descripcion_larga: Players control Bloop, a small blue creature that must jump over obstacles and avoid enemies. Like many unlicensed titles, it has basic physics and repetitive level design, often appearing on budget multi-carts in the late 90s.

objetivo: Catch record-breaking Marlin and win the tournament.
descripcion_corta: A realistic sea-fishing sim that focuses on large ocean prey.
descripcion_larga: This game focuses on "Big Game" fishing. Players must manage boat movement, fuel, and line tension while battling massive fish. It features an overhead view for tracking and a specialized "battle" view when a Marlin is on the hook.

objetivo: Win the Florida fishing tournament by catching the heaviest Marlin.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the realistic sea-fishing title.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the Japanese version, it offers a surprisingly deep simulation. You can select different lures and locations based on weather conditions. The "fight" with the fish is a strategic tug-of-war that can last several minutes of game time.

objetivo: Infiltrate a futuristic New York to defeat the Emperor Garuda.
descripcion_corta: The European version of the acclaimed "Shadow of the Ninja."
descripcion_larga: Often called the "cousin" of Ninja Gaiden, this game features 2-player simultaneous co-op. Players use katanas, kusarigamas, and bombs. It is praised for its exceptional graphics, fluid animation, and some of the best music on the system.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer based on the movie.
objetivo: Collect the missing records to perform the big show.
descripcion_corta: A musical adventure starring Jake and Elwood Blues.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose either brother to navigate stages like a prison, a mall, and a construction site. The gameplay focuses on picking up and throwing crates at enemies. It is known for its faithful 8-bit renditions of blues and soul classics.

gameplay: Side-scrolling platformer based on the movie.
objetivo: Dodge the police and reach the concert hall in time.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Blues Brothers platformer.
descripcion_larga: This version maintains the same levels and challenge as the European release. It captures the frantic energy of the film, requiring precise jumping and item management while the iconic "Peter Gunn Theme" or "Everybody Needs Somebody" plays in the background.

gameplay: Baseball simulation with a multi-sport star.
objetivo: Win the championship using Bo Jackson's athletic prowess.
descripcion_corta: A sports sim endorsed by the legendary MLB and NFL star.
descripcion_larga: The game features Bo Jackson as the main star and allows for exhibition or season play. It is notable for its digitized voice of Bo Jackson and a more arcade-style approach to pitching and batting compared to the more serious Bases Loaded series.

objetivo: Lead your army across the screen to defeat the evil King Kingder.
descripcion_corta: A unique and early tactical game where you move an entire army.
descripcion_larga: Players start with only a King and must "touch" tiles to recruit soldiers. All characters move simultaneously when you press a direction. It is considered one of the earliest examples of the strategy-RPG genre, known for its iconic "Bokosuka" chant music.

objetivo: Navigate through enemy-filled stages to destroy the final boss.
descripcion_corta: A spin-off of the Bomberman series with more adventure elements.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as RoboWarrior, players control a robot that uses bombs to clear paths and fight. Unlike Bomberman, it features a life bar, various weapon upgrades, and an energy meter that constantly depletes, requiring the player to find fuel.

objetivo: Use bombs to clear enemies and stages in a Bomberman-style world.
descripcion_corta: A modern homebrew hack featuring characters from the Touhou Project.
descripcion_larga: This is a fan-made modification (hack) of the original Bomberman. It replaces the classic protagonist with Remilia Scarlet from the Touhou series, featuring new sprites and potentially modified music while keeping the classic "place bombs and run" gameplay.

objetivo: Destroy all enemies in each stage and find the exit hidden under a brick.
descripcion_corta: The Famicom original that launched the legendary explosive franchise.
descripcion_larga: Players control a robot trying to become human. By placing bombs to destroy walls and enemies, you find power-ups like Fire (range) and Bombs (quantity). It is a simple but incredibly addictive game that defined the "maze-action" genre.

objetivo: Complete 50 levels of explosive action to become human.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the iconic Bomberman.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the Japanese version, it tells the story of a bomb-making robot who escapes a factory. It is praised for its perfect difficulty curve and strategic depth, where one misplaced bomb can lead to the player's own demise.

objetivo: Escape from prison by clearing stages with bombs.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese sequel known as Bomberman II.
descripcion_larga: This version introduced a much-needed 3-player battle mode (using a multitap) and improved the single-player campaign with more diverse environments and enemy types. It set the standard for the multiplayer chaos the series is now famous for.

objetivo: Clear your name by escaping prison and defeating the fake Bomberman.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the second Bomberman title.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a story mode where Bomberman is framed for a crime, this game is highly sought after by collectors. It significantly improved the graphics over the original and refined the power-up system, making the gameplay faster and more fluid.

objetivo: Defeat enemies using the female "Pretty Bomber" character.
descripcion_corta: A cosmetic hack of Bomberman featuring the series' female rival.
descripcion_larga: This modification replaces the standard white Bomberman with Pretty Bomber (Lady Bomber). The core mechanics of placing bombs and collecting power-ups remain the same, providing a fun visual alternative for fans of the character.

objetivo: Use your head to bash enemies and rescue Princess Za.
descripcion_corta: A rare NES port of the famous TurboGrafx-16 mascot game.
descripcion_larga: Players control Bonk, a caveman who attacks by "headbutting" or diving head-first. By eating meat, Bonk can transform into more powerful versions. Despite the hardware downgrade, this version captures the charm and creative level design of the original.

objetivo: Collect all items in the stage and reach the exit before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: A prehistoric puzzle game where you trap enemies in holes.
descripcion_larga: Players control a "Booby Kid" who can dig holes to trap pursuing enemies, similar to Lode Runner or Heiankyo Alien. You must navigate maze-like levels, collect treasures, and use strategic digging to survive various prehistoric hazards.

objetivo: Defeat enemies using gross-out powers to reach the end of the stage.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit bootleg port of the 16-bit gross-out hero game.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Hummer Team, this is an unlicensed adaptation of the SEGA/SNES game. Players use burps and "flickers" to fight enemies. Despite being a pirate game, it features surprisingly decent animations and music for the NES hardware.

objetivo: Navigate new "gross" levels and defeat the Boogerman rivals.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed sequel/hack of the first 8-bit Boogerman.
descripcion_larga: Often based on the same engine as the first unlicensed port, this version features modified level layouts and sometimes different enemy colors. It remains a curiosity of the pirate game market, focusing on the same scatological humor as the original.

objetivo: Collect a set number of diamonds and reach the exit before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: The European version of the classic "dig and collect" puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: As Rockford, players must dig through dirt while avoiding falling rocks and enemies. The game is famous for its emergent physics: one wrong move can cause a rock-slide that traps the player or crushes vital diamonds.

objetivo: Navigate caves and avoid being crushed by falling boulders.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the iconic puzzle series.
descripcion_larga: Published by Data East in Japan, this version features the same addictive logic-based gameplay. Players must solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles, managing the movement of boulders to clear paths or eliminate underground creatures.

objetivo: Master the caves and collect enough jewels to open the escape portal.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the legendary Boulder Dash.
descripcion_larga: This version established Rockford as a household name for puzzle fans. It features dozens of levels (caves) that require a perfect mix of quick reflexes and long-term planning to avoid getting stuck in a dead-end.

nombre: Boulder Dash (USA) [Hack by Dragon Eye Studios v0.80] (~Boulder Dash Greed)
objetivo: Collect diamonds in high-difficulty custom caves.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made hack titled "Boulder Dash Greed" with new levels.
descripcion_larga: This modification replaces the original 1990 levels with much more punishing and complex designs. It is intended for veterans of the series who have mastered the physics of falling rocks and want a fresh, logical challenge.

objetivo: Navigate levels as a fan-made "Bowsette" character.
descripcion_corta: A visual mod of a classic platformer (usually SMB2) featuring Bowsette.
descripcion_larga: Part of a series of "Bowsette" themed hacks, the "Red" version typically features a specific color palette and sprite set. The gameplay follows the standard platforming rules of the base game it modifies, but with the internet-famous character.

objetivo: Complete stages with the Yellow-themed Bowsette sprite.
descripcion_corta: Another color variant of the Bowsette character modification.
descripcion_larga: Similar to the "Red" version, this is a cosmetic hack. It serves as a visual alternative for fans of the character, often featuring minor tweaks to the difficulty or item placements depending on the specific patch version.

nombre: Boy and His Blob, A - Trouble on Blobolonia (Europe) (Rev A)
objetivo: Feed your blob jellybeans to transform him and solve puzzles.
descripcion_corta: An innovative adventure by David Crane (creator of Pitfall!).
descripcion_larga: Players control a boy who is accompanied by a shape-shifting blob. By feeding him different flavors of jellybeans, the blob turns into a ladder, a bridge, a hole, etc. The European Rev A version includes minor technical bug fixes.

nombre: Boy and His Blob, A - Trouble on Blobolonia (USA)
objetivo: Travel to the planet Blobolonia to defeat the evil Vitamin King.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the unique "blob" adventure.
descripcion_larga: A cult classic known for its experimental gameplay. There is no "jump" button; instead, you must strategically use the blob's transformations to navigate the environment. It requires a lot of trial-and-error and creative thinking to progress.

objetivo: Defeat the vampire Lucy, the brides, and eventually Count Dracula.
descripcion_corta: A movie-licensed action game with a dark, gothic atmosphere.
descripcion_larga: Based on the 1992 film, players control Jonathan Harker. The game features a day/night cycle that affects difficulty. You fight through forests and castles using a knife and various secondary weapons. It is noted for its impressive graphics and somber music.

objetivo: Pursue the Count across Europe to save Mina and end the curse.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Bram Stoker movie tie-in.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it offers a challenging platforming experience. Each level is divided into daytime (easier) and nighttime (harder) sections. The boss fights are a highlight, featuring various forms of Dracula’s minions.

nombre: Break Time - The National Pool Tour (USA)
objetivo: Win the national tour by defeating professional pool players.
descripcion_corta: A realistic pool game with physics-based gameplay.
descripcion_larga: Players can compete in several modes, including 8-ball, 9-ball, and rotation. It features a power meter and the ability to add "English" (spin) to the ball. The game includes a tour mode where you travel to different cities to compete for prize money.

objetivo: Drive through enemy territory to rescue a captured fighter jet.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced action game where you control an armored buggy.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Data East, your vehicle can jump over obstacles and shoot in multiple directions. The game is known for its speed and the "Breakthru" mechanic where you must literally crash through enemy lines to reach the boss at the end of each stage.

objetivo: Paint all the paths in the maze while avoiding pursuing monsters.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed clone of the arcade classic Make Trax (Crush Roller).
descripcion_larga: Players control a brush that leaves a trail of color. You must paint the entire floor of the maze to advance. It features "rollers" that can be used to crush enemies, and like many unlicensed Asian titles, it has simple graphics but addictive arcade-style gameplay.

objetivo: Clear the bubbles to reveal a hidden image of a woman.
descripcion_corta: A rare and controversial adult-themed puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Published by Panesian, this is a "Bubble Buster" style game. While the gameplay is a standard tile-matching puzzle, it is infamous for its adult content shown between levels. It is one of the most sought-after and expensive unlicensed cartridges for collectors.

objetivo: Trap all enemies in bubbles and pop them to clear the stage.
descripcion_corta: The European release of Taito's legendary arcade masterpiece.
descripcion_larga: Players control Bub or Bob (dragons). The game is famous for its 100 levels, cooperative 2-player mode, and catchy music. To get the "True Ending," players must complete the game in 2-player mode, emphasizing teamwork and strategy.

objetivo: Defeat Baron Von Blubba and rescue the dragons' girlfriends.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the classic Bubble Bobble.
descripcion_larga: This version brought the perfect arcade loop to Western homes. It features a deep scoring system involving fruit, items, and secret "EXTEND" bubbles. It remains one of the most beloved and replayable titles in the entire NES library.

nombre: Bubble Bobble (USA) [Hack by Dragon Eye Studios v1.0] (~Bubble Bobble Madness)
objetivo: Survive extreme new levels in "Bubble Bobble Madness."
descripcion_corta: A high-difficulty modification of the original game.
descripcion_larga: Created by Dragon Eye Studios, this hack replaces all 100 original levels with brand-new, much more difficult layouts. It is designed for experts who can navigate tight spaces and manage enemy patterns with perfect precision.

objetivo: Journey through new worlds to save the village from evil.
descripcion_corta: The rare and highly polished sequel to Bubble Bobble.
descripcion_larga: Released late in the Famicom's life, this sequel features vastly improved graphics and new abilities, such as the power to float by holding the jump button. It is a technical showcase for the system and one of the most expensive original cartridges today.

objetivo: Rescue your friend and defeat the evil skull monster.
descripcion_corta: The extremely rare and polished North American sequel.
descripcion_larga: Released late in the NES lifecycle, this sequel features much larger sprites and more detailed backgrounds than the original. It introduces new mechanics like the ability to float and updated boss patterns. It is one of the most valuable licensed titles for collectors today.

nombre: Bubble Bobble Part 2 (USA) [Hack by Dragon Eye Studios v0.15] (~Bubble Bobble Madness 2)
objetivo: Challenge yourself with redesigned, high-difficulty stages.
descripcion_corta: A technical hack that overhauls the levels of Bubble Bobble Part 2.
descripcion_larga: Following the "Madness" series by Dragon Eye Studios, this modification replaces the original stages with complex, trap-filled layouts. It is designed for players who have mastered the physics of the second game and seek a professional-level challenge.

objetivo: Rescue your crew members and stop the Toad Empire.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality Konami action game based on the cult cartoon.
descripcion_larga: Players travel to different planets (Green, Red, Blue, etc.) to save crewmates like Blinky and Jenny. Once rescued, you can switch between characters at any time, each with unique abilities required to overcome specific platforming obstacles.

objetivo: Save the galaxy from the Toad Air Marshall.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the Bucky O'Hare adventure.
descripcion_larga: Identical in its excellent gameplay to the Western versions, this release showcases Konami's "VRC" chip capabilities with fluid animations and a pulse-pounding soundtrack that is often cited as some of the best music on the 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Liberate the planets from Toad control and rescue the Righteous Indignation crew.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the acclaimed Bucky O'Hare.
descripcion_larga: Regarded as a "hidden gem," it combines Mega Man-style level selection with tight platforming and character-swapping mechanics. It is notoriously difficult but highly rewarding, featuring some of the most creative level designs on the system.

objetivo: Reach the goal while jumping over obstacles and destroying enemies.
descripcion_corta: An arcade-style racer known in the West as Bump 'n' Jump.
descripcion_larga: Players drive a car that can "jump" into the air to land on top of enemies or cross large gaps in the road. It’s a fast-paced game where you must manage your speed and timing to survive the chaotic highway traffic and water hazards.

objetivo: Reach Bugs Bunny's 50th birthday party while dodging classic rivals.
descripcion_corta: A colorful platformer celebrating the iconic Looney Tunes character.
descripcion_larga: Known in Japan as Happy Birthday Bugs, players use a mallet to defeat enemies like Elmer Fudd and Yosemite Sam. The game features various bonus stages and a "lucky draw" system to earn extra lives and power-ups at the end of each level.

objetivo: Navigate through Looney Tunes-themed levels to reach the celebration.
descripcion_corta: The European release of the Bugs Bunny birthday adventure.
descripcion_larga: Aside from the slight title change, the gameplay remains a standard but charming platformer. It focuses on collecting carrots and avoiding traps, with a lighthearted tone and music that fits the whimsical nature of the cartoons.

objetivo: Collect all the carrots in each level to open the exit door.
descripcion_corta: A strategy-focused game set in a multi-level castle.
descripcion_larga: Unlike other Bugs Bunny games, there is no jumping. Players must use stairs, ladders, and pipes to outmaneuver enemies. It requires careful planning to use items like boxing gloves and weights to trap rivals while clearing the stage.

nombre: Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, The (USA) [Hack by Frank Maggiore v1.2] (~2nd Ultimate Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, The)
objetivo: Solve even more complex puzzles in this custom level pack.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made expansion with brand-new, challenging castle levels.
descripcion_larga: This modification takes the core mechanics of Crazy Castle and introduces much more intricate level designs. It tests the player's ability to manipulate enemy AI and manage limited resources across dozens of new rooms.

objetivo: Collect every carrot in the castle while outsmarting classic cartoon enemies.
descripcion_corta: A significant level overhaul of the original puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: This hack replaces all the original stages with much more difficult and complex designs. It requires perfect timing and expert knowledge of the enemy AI patterns to navigate through the traps and collect the items needed to clear each room.

objetivo: Navigate through various rooms to find the exit and progress.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype version of the Bugs Bunny puzzle series.
descripcion_larga: This version provides a look at the game's development before its final release. While the core gameplay of collecting items to open doors remains the same, it features slight differences in level layouts and assets compared to the retail version.

objetivo: Reach the finish line by jumping over obstacles and crashing into rivals.
descripcion_corta: A port of the high-speed arcade classic Buggy Popper.
descripcion_larga: Players drive a car that has the unique ability to jump into the air. This mechanic is used to dodge water hazards, leap over large gaps, and land on top of enemy vehicles to destroy them. It is a fast-paced game of reflexes and timing.

objetivo: Travel through multiple bases to eliminate the Burai super-beings.
descripcion_corta: A technically impressive shooter with 8-way scrolling action.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Taxan, the game allows players to fire in eight different directions while the screen scrolls in various ways. It features complex level designs and a variety of weapon power-ups like lasers and missiles to tackle large bosses.

objetivo: Eradicate the alien threat across different planetary bases.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the sci-fi shooter known for its difficulty.
descripcion_larga: This version offers the same intense shooting action as its Western counterparts. Players must manage their movement carefully as the scrolling changes direction, requiring mastery of the 8-way firing system to survive the onslaught of enemies.

objetivo: Destroy the Burai Empire using an array of advanced weaponry.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the acclaimed multi-directional shmup.
descripcion_larga: It is highly regarded for its smooth scrolling and challenging gameplay. The game includes several difficulty levels, including a hidden "Eagle" mode that is considered one of the toughest challenges on the NES hardware.

objetivo: Assemble all the hamburgers by walking over the ingredients.
descripcion_corta: The Famicom port of Data East's legendary arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: As Peter Pepper the chef, you must drop buns, patties, and lettuce onto plates below. You are pursued by personified food enemies like Mr. Hot Dog and Mr. Egg, whom you can stun with limited pepper or crush with falling ingredients.

objetivo: Finish making every burger in the stage while avoiding enemies.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the iconic arcade puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: This port captures the addictive "cat and mouse" gameplay of the original. Success depends on strategic movement to group enemies together under falling food items to earn high scores and clear the stage faster.

objetivo: Outperform rival companies to dominate the Japanese corporate market.
descripcion_corta: A strategy-heavy business simulation focused on economics.
descripcion_larga: Players compete on a board to buy properties, manage stocks, and grow their corporate empire. It features a deep menu system and requires careful financial planning to defeat the computer-controlled business rivals.

objetivo: Help the duo save their world from a massive alien invasion.
descripcion_corta: A highly polished unreleased prototype from industry veterans.
descripcion_larga: Created by former Konami staff, this game features exceptional animations and tight controls. It follows Buzz and his dog Waldog through vibrant levels, showcasing the quality of a retail game that unfortunately never saw a commercial release.

objetivo: Destroy all enemy soldiers and structures in each combat zone.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the intense arcade shooting-gallery game.
descripcion_larga: Players control a soldier who can move horizontally and dodge-roll to avoid fire while aiming a crosshair at targets. The environment is highly destructible, and clearing a stage is rewarded with the character's signature victory dance.

nombre: Cadillac (Japan) [En by Gil Galad+Steve Martin v1.0]
gameplay: Board game / Strategy with RPG elements
objetivo: Use cards and strategy to win the tournament and advance.
descripcion_corta: A Famicom board game featuring card-based combat.
descripcion_larga: Based on a digital board game format, players move across a map and engage in events determined by card draws. It requires a balance of luck and tactical thinking to manage resources and overcome the challenges presented by the board.

objetivo: Win big at various casino games to increase your bankroll.
descripcion_corta: An officially licensed simulation of the famous Las Vegas casino.
descripcion_larga: Featuring games like Blackjack, Roulette, Slot Machines, and Video Poker, this title aims for a realistic gambling experience. It includes a high-stakes area for players who accumulate enough wealth, following strict casino rules and odds.

objetivo: Master various "extreme" sports to earn high scores and medals.
descripcion_corta: A multi-event sports game celebrating California subculture.
descripcion_larga: Players compete in events such as Skateboarding, Footbag, Surfing, Roller Skating, BMX, and Flying Disc. Each event has unique controls and physics, requiring different skills to master the quintessential West Coast athletic experience.

objetivo: Compete in six different California-themed summer sports.
descripcion_corta: The North American release of the Epyx multi-event classic.
descripcion_larga: Identical to the European version, it is beloved for its colorful graphics and competitive multiplayer. Players can represent different sponsors and must balance risk and reward to pull off stunts without wiping out.

objetivo: Rescue your bandmates and retrieve the stolen musical notes.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype featuring the famous claymation mascots.
descripcion_larga: This early build shows the core mechanics of the raisins' adventure. It features a mix of platforming and shooting (using musical notes) with diverse level themes, though it contains bugs and unfinished assets typical of an early prototype.

objetivo: Stop the villainous Maestro and save the California Raisins.
descripcion_corta: A more polished, near-complete version of the cancelled game.
descripcion_larga: This second prototype is significantly more stable and features complete levels, boss fights, and cinematic interludes. It showcases impressive character animation and a creative use of the license that was sadly never officially released.

objetivo: Play through six different titles included on a single cartridge.
descripcion_corta: A rare unlicensed multicart containing six original games.
descripcion_larga: Includes Cosmic Fighter, Adam & Eve, Magic Carpet 1001, Balloon Monster, Porter, and Bookyman. These games vary in genre from shooters to puzzles, though they are generally simpler in design than official Nintendo releases.

objetivo: Lead your athlete to victory in various Olympic events.
