descripcion_larga: This version showcases the localized version that was never officially released, featuring the same high-intensity combat and challenging 8-bit level design.

objetivo: Collect crystals and find the exit while managing rocks and explosives.
descripcion_corta: A strategic puzzle game where mining meets 8-bit logic and reflexes.
descripcion_larga: Similar to Boulder Dash, Crystal Mines tasks players with navigating hazardous underground caves, using bombs strategically to clear paths without getting trapped.

objetivo: Gather four elemental swords to defeat the Draygonian Empire and save the world.
descripcion_corta: One of the most beloved and deepest Action-RPGs in the NES library.
descripcion_larga: Set in a post-apocalyptic world, Crystalis features fluid real-time combat, a deep magic system, and a sprawling world to explore, often compared favorably to the Zelda series.

objetivo: Gather four elemental swords to defeat the Draygonian Empire and save the world.
descripcion_corta: An early prototype of the masterpiece Crystalis with minor gameplay differences.
descripcion_larga: This beta offers a look at the game's development process, featuring the same epic story and mechanics with slight variations in text or item placement.

objetivo: Navigate difficult levels as Cutman to defeat the other Robot Masters.
descripcion_corta: A creative Mega Man hack where you play as the iconic boss, Cutman.
descripcion_larga: This total conversion changes the protagonist and level layouts, offering a fresh and much more difficult challenge for fans of the original Mega Man series.

objetivo: Win high-stakes football games using robotic players and explosive balls.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit take on American football with robots and strategic depth.
descripcion_larga: In Cyberball, the ball heats up and can explode if not moved quickly. Players must manage their robot team's durability and choose the right plays to outscore the opposition.

objetivo: Navigate a complex ship through hazardous tunnels to recover stolen treasure.
descripcion_corta: A highly difficult and strategic shooter known for its puzzle-like level design.
descripcion_larga: Cybernoid requires precision flying and careful use of limited sub-weapons. Each screen is a deadly trap filled with enemies and environmental hazards.

objetivo: Manage your stamina and speed to win the ultimate road bike championship.
descripcion_corta: A unique and realistic take on competitive cycling for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Players must balance the physical output of their racer with strategic positioning in the pack, managing energy levels across various long-distance stages.

objetivo: Navigate through complex 3D labyrinths to find the exit before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: A challenging first-person maze exploration game that tests your sense of direction.
descripcion_larga: Dai Meiro (Great Maze) puts players in a 3D perspective, tasking them with mapping out intricate corridors and avoiding traps to master the labyrinth in this unique 8-bit experience.

nombre: Dai Meiro - Meikyuu no Tatsujin (Japan) [En by Filler+KingMike v1.0] (~Great Maze - Master of the Maze)

descripcion_corta: The English translation of the 3D dungeon exploration game Dai Meiro.

objetivo: Command a team of iconic mechs to defeat enemy forces in strategic combat.
descripcion_corta: The legendary second entry in the Super Robot Wars series featuring famous anime mechs.
descripcion_larga: This title laid the groundwork for the franchise, combining tactical grid-based movement with cinematic battle animations featuring robots from Gundam, Mazinger Z, and more.

objetivo: Defend the city from giant monsters (Kaiju) using military units and tactics.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit strategy game focused on giant monster battles and city defense.
descripcion_larga: Players must strategically deploy tanks, jets, and specialized weapons to halt the path of destruction caused by massive Kaiju, blending military simulation with classic monster movie vibes.

objetivo: Build a fleet, discover new lands, and amass wealth through global trade.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom version of the epic seafaring adventure, "Uncharted Waters."
descripcion_larga: Set during the Age of Discovery, this game offers a massive open world where players must manage crew morale, ship supplies, and market prices to become the king of the seas.

objetivo: Use your hammer to defeat construction rivals and save the neighborhood.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy action game starring the famous Hammerin' Harry.
descripcion_larga: Players control Gen-san, a heroic carpenter, in a quest to stop a corrupt construction company. The game is known for its fast-paced combat and creative use of hammer power-ups.

nombre: Daiku no Gen San 2 - Akage no Dan no Gyakushuu (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat Dan and his gang using your powerful hammer skills.
descripcion_corta: The vibrant sequel to Hammerin' Harry with more levels and improved graphics.
descripcion_larga: Gen-san returns for more 8-bit action, featuring smoother animations and larger bosses. Players must master timing and hammer strikes to clear through challenging urban environments.

objetivo: Outmaneuver enemy armies and capture bases in modern warfare scenarios.
descripcion_corta: A deep and realistic turn-based war simulator for strategy enthusiasts.
descripcion_larga: Daisenryaku is a cornerstone of the strategy genre, offering complex unit management (tanks, planes, infantry) across varied terrain to achieve military dominance on the map.

objetivo: Outmaneuver enemy armies and capture bases in modern warfare scenarios.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the legendary military strategy game Daisenryaku.
descripcion_larga: This version translates the deep tactical menus and unit stats of Daisenryaku, making one of the most complex Famicom strategy titles playable for English speakers.

objetivo: Conquer planetary systems through fleet management and side-scrolling combat.
descripcion_corta: An ambitious sci-fi epic that blends space strategy with 8-bit action levels.
descripcion_larga: Daiva features a dual-gameplay loop: players manage ship deployments on a galactic map and then pilot a mech in side-scrolling segments to secure planetary targets.

objetivo: Follow the instructor's moves on the Power Pad to complete aerobic routines.
descripcion_corta: An early fitness game that utilizes the NES Power Pad for a full-body workout.
descripcion_larga: Using the Power Pad peripheral, players must step on the correct buttons in rhythm with the music, mimicking the movements of an on-screen instructor in this retro fitness classic.

objetivo: Win Indy-style races to earn money and upgrade your car's performance.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced arcade racer featuring pit stops and high-speed competition.
descripcion_larga: Known for its tight controls and four-player support, Indy Heat challenges players to manage fuel and tire wear in a series of intense, high-speed tracks across the globe.

objetivo: Assemble a party of heroes to defeat ancient evils and explore dark dungeons.
descripcion_corta: A sophisticated late-release Famicom RPG with high-quality 8-bit graphics.
descripcion_larga: Dark Lord features a non-linear quest structure and a deep tactical combat system, allowing players to customize their party and choose their path through a dark fantasy world.

nombre: Dark Lord (Japan) [En by Aeon Genesis v1.0]
objetivo: Assemble a party of heroes to defeat ancient evils and explore dark dungeons.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the deep and dark fantasy RPG, Dark Lord.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation opens up the complex world-building and strategic combat of Dark Lord, making it a must-play for fans of 8-bit tactical role-playing games.

objetivo: Use disguises and combat skills to take revenge on the crime syndicate.
descripcion_corta: A gritty movie-based action game featuring a unique "mask" mechanic.
descripcion_larga: Based on the Sam Raimi film, players control Peyton Westlake, battling through levels and taking photos of enemies to create masks that allow them to infiltrate various stages.

descripcion_corta: A gameplay-focused hack designed to modernize the original Darkwing Duck.
descripcion_larga: This version often features tweaked physics or modified level layouts, intended to give the classic 8-bit game a more modern or "Advanced" difficulty feel.

nombre: Dash Galaxy in the Alien Asylum (USA)
objetivo: Navigate a series of hazardous rooms in an alien asylum to find the exit.
descripcion_corta: A challenging blend of top-down exploration and side-scrolling platforming.
descripcion_larga: As Dash Galaxy, players must solve environmental puzzles and avoid deadly alien traps across numerous floors in this sci-fi adventure that rewards careful planning.

objetivo: Race through various tracks and avoid obstacles to reach the finish line.
descripcion_corta: An early Famicom racer with simple controls and addictive high-speed action.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Deadly Towers" in some circles (incorrectly), Dash Yarou is a pure racing game that focuses on lane-changing and speed management to beat the clock.

nombre: Datach - Battle Rush - Build Up Robot Tournament (Japan)
objetivo: Customize and battle robots in a tournament using the Datach peripheral.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit robot fighter designed for the barcode-reading Datach system.
descripcion_larga: Part of the Datach series, this game allowed players to "scan" barcodes to generate robot stats, battling them in a competitive 8-bit arena.

nombre: Datach - Crayon Shin Chan - Ora to Poi Poi (Japan)
objetivo: Complete various Shin-Chan themed challenges using the Datach reader.
descripcion_corta: A barcode-integrated puzzle game based on the Crayon Shin-Chan series.
descripcion_larga: This version of Shin-Chan uses the specialized Datach hardware to unlock content or characters via barcodes, adding a physical collectible element to the 8-bit gameplay.

nombre: Datach - Dragon Ball Z - Gekitou Tenkaichi Budou Kai (Japan)
objetivo: Win the World Martial Arts Tournament using scanned character stats.
descripcion_corta: A unique Dragon Ball Z fighter where barcodes determine your power levels.
descripcion_larga: Part of the Datach system, this title lets fans scan barcodes to summon fighters. It features iconic DBZ characters and fast-paced 8-bit combat centered around the legendary Tenkaichi Budou Kai tournament.

nombre: Datach - J League Super Top Players (Japan)
objetivo: Lead your J-League team to the championship using scanned player data.
descripcion_corta: A barcode-driven soccer game featuring real Japanese league players.
descripcion_larga: This sports title utilizes the Datach joint to scan real-world cards, allowing players to build a custom roster of J-League stars and compete in strategic 11-on-11 soccer matches.

objetivo: Command a squad of SD Gundams to defeat enemy forces in space and land.
descripcion_corta: A strategic Gundam war game where units are unlocked via barcode scanning.
descripcion_larga: Gundam Wars combines tactical map movement with individual 8-bit combat encounters. Players use the Datach reader to strengthen their fleet and deploy iconic mobile suits from the Gundam universe.

objetivo: Compete in various physical challenges to prove Ultraman's strength.
descripcion_corta: A competitive sports collection featuring the legendary Ultraman characters.
descripcion_larga: This Datach entry focuses on "Supokon" (sports spirit), where players scan codes to improve their stats in various athletic mini-games, blending Tokusatsu action with competitive sports mechanics.

nombre: Datach - Yuu Yuu Hakusho - Bakutou Ankoku Bujutsu Kai (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the demons of the Dark Tournament through strategic combat.
descripcion_corta: A cinematic fighter based on the hit Yuu Yuu Hakusho anime series.
descripcion_larga: Players use the Datach reader to influence the battle power of Yusuke and his friends. The game recreates the intense Dark Tournament arc with large sprites and anime-inspired special moves.

objetivo: Escape from a high-security prison by fighting waves of guards and soldiers.
descripcion_corta: A gritty 8-bit brawler known in the West as "POW: Prisoners of War."
descripcion_larga: Control a soldier fighting his way out of enemy territory. The game features various weapons like knives and guns, offering a tough military combat experience with a dark, urban aesthetic.

objetivo: Navigate through Davey's daydreams to defeat historical and fantasy bosses.
descripcion_corta: A unique adventure where a boy's imagination takes him to different eras.
descripcion_larga: As Davey, players explore ancient Greece, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West. Each dream features different weapons and mechanics, blending top-down exploration with side-scrolling action.

objetivo: Master the oval tracks to win the NASCAR championship.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed racing game based on the Tom Cruise movie.
descripcion_larga: Days of Thunder focuses on strategy and pit management. Players must manage fuel, tire wear, and car damage while competing at high speeds against a full pack of aggressive stock car racers.

objetivo: Master the oval tracks to win the NASCAR championship.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed racing game based on the Tom Cruise movie.
descripcion_larga: Days of Thunder focuses on strategy and pit management. Players must manage fuel, tire wear, and car damage while competing at high speeds against a full pack of aggressive stock car racers.

objetivo: Explore seven towers to find and destroy the bells of evil.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and sprawling 8-bit fantasy adventure.
descripcion_larga: As Prince Myer, players must navigate a massive world filled with hidden portals and difficult enemies. It is known for its steep challenge curve and non-linear exploration of a dark fantasy kingdom.

objetivo: Fight through levels as the "Merc with a Mouth" to defeat various villains.
descripcion_corta: A modern fan-made hack featuring the popular Marvel character Deadpool.
descripcion_larga: This modification of Ninja Gaiden (or similar) replaces the protagonist with Deadpool, adding his signature look and weapons to create a fast-paced, high-difficulty superhero experience.

objetivo: Drive through post-apocalyptic tracks and destroy rivals to win the race.
descripcion_corta: A violent and gritty unlicensed racer inspired by the cult classic movie.
descripcion_larga: Published by American Video Entertainment, Death Race challenges players to race through dangerous circuits while using car-mounted weapons to take down opponents and obstacles in a race for survival.

objetivo: Infiltrate a robotic facility and destroy the central computer core.
descripcion_corta: A futuristic shooter featuring maze-like levels and robotic enemies.
descripcion_larga: Control a powerful combat droid as you navigate through complex floors filled with traps and hostile bots. The game requires careful movement and precise shooting to survive the mechanical gauntlet.

objetivo: Infiltrate a robotic facility and destroy the central computer core.
descripcion_corta: A futuristic shooter featuring maze-like levels and robotic enemies.
descripcion_larga: This initial version of the unlicensed title offers the same challenging isometric combat as the player fights through a sci-fi fortress to disable a rogue AI.

objetivo: Match shapes and clear lines to prevent the screen from filling up.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit puzzle game that tests spatial awareness and speed.
descripcion_larga: Deblock offers a fresh take on the puzzle genre, requiring players to manipulate blocks in a way that differs from Tetris, focusing on completing specific patterns to advance stages.

objetivo: Compete in ten different track and field events to win the gold medal.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed take on the classic Olympic decathlon experience.
descripcion_larga: Featuring events like the 100m dash, long jump, and javelin throw, this game requires rapid button pressing and precise timing to break world records and achieve the highest total score.

objetivo: Navigate deep labyrinths to defeat an ancient evil and find treasure.
descripcion_corta: A classic 3D-style dungeon RPG with turn-based combat and exploration.
descripcion_larga: As the third entry in the series, it refines the first-person exploration of hazardous caves and dungeons, featuring a party system and challenging 8-bit monster encounters.

objetivo: Stop the black sorcerer by exploring a massive 3D labyrinth.
descripcion_corta: The final Famicom entry in the legendary Deep Dungeon series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring improved graphics and deeper RPG mechanics, players must manage a group of adventurers as they map out a complex world filled with traps, puzzles, and powerful magic.

nombre: Deep Dungeon 4 - Kuro no Youjutsushi (Japan) [En by Dragoon-X v1.0] [Mapper Fix by Spinner 8] (~Deep Dungeon 4 - The Black Sorcerer)

descripcion_larga: This translation opens up the complex narrative and spell systems of the final Deep Dungeon title, making this classic first-person dungeon crawler accessible to English speakers.

objetivo: Rebuild a powerful magical sword to defeat the dark forces of the underworld.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced fantasy action game featuring massive jumps and sword combat.
descripcion_larga: Players control a warrior on a quest to recover blade fragments. The game is known for its high-flying acrobatics, impressive boss battles, and power-ups that increase the sword's length and power.

objetivo: Use your energy blasts to navigate levels and defeat a robotic army.
descripcion_corta: A visually striking action game known in the West as "Clash at Demonhead."
descripcion_larga: This original Japanese version features the same non-linear exploration and quirky anime style, where players use different suits and gadgets to progress through a massive interconnected map.

objetivo: Journey through a fantasy world to defeat the evil sorcerer and save the land.
descripcion_corta: An early Famicom RPG-lite experience known in the West as "Wizards & Warriors."
descripcion_larga: Players control Kuros, a knight who explores forests and caves, collecting gems and upgrades. It features iconic 8-bit platforming and challenging boss encounters in a dark fantasy setting.

objetivo: Breed, train, and race horses to become the top stable owner in Japan.
descripcion_corta: A deep and realistic horse racing management simulator for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Derby Stallion focuses on the strategic side of racing. Players must manage bloodlines, training schedules, and betting strategies to build a winning legacy in the competitive world of horse racing.

objetivo: Deploy tanks, planes, and infantry to capture the enemy's headquarters.
descripcion_corta: A tactical desert warfare simulator with a focus on unit management.
descripcion_larga: Set in North Africa during WWII, Desert Commander provides a grid-based strategy experience where terrain, fuel, and unit strengths must be carefully balanced to achieve military victory.

objetivo: Pilot a starship through enemy territory to reach Earth and stop an invasion.
descripcion_corta: A dual-genre sci-fi adventure blending cockpit combat with platforming.
descripcion_larga: Destination Earthstar switches between first-person space flight and side-scrolling planetary missions, requiring players to master both flight simulation and traditional 8-bit action.

objetivo: Recruit generals and lead an army to unify ancient China.
descripcion_corta: An epic historical RPG based on the Three Kingdoms era and the "Tenchi wo Kurau" manga.
descripcion_larga: Unlike traditional RPGs, this game focuses on large-scale army battles where HP is represented by the number of soldiers. Players can recruit over 150 unique generals in their quest for conquest.

objetivo: Battle demons and protect humanity by transforming into the powerful Devilman.
descripcion_corta: A dark and gritty action game based on Go Nagai's legendary manga series.
descripcion_larga: Devil Man blends exploration and combat, staying faithful to the series' violent and tragic tone. Players must navigate urban and demonic realms to stop the coming apocalypse.

descripcion_larga: Dig Dug is a legendary Namco title. Players must navigate through soil, strategicially avoiding the Pookas and Fygars while using their pump to inflate enemies until they pop, or dropping rocks to crush them for extra points.

nombre: Dig Dug II - Trouble in Paradise (USA)
objetivo: Destroy all enemies by inflating them or sinking parts of the island.
descripcion_corta: A unique sequel that moves the digging action from underground to island surfaces.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, Dig Dug II takes place on islands. Players can use a jackhammer to create faults in the ground, causing entire sections of the land (and the enemies on them) to sink into the ocean.

objetivo: Destroy all enemies by inflating them or sinking parts of the island.

descripcion_corta: A challenging underground adventure focused on exploration and survival.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Rare, Digger T. Rock tasks players with using shovels, ladders, and explosives to traverse hazardous caverns. It requires careful resource management and quick reflexes to find the exit of each level.

descripcion_larga: Based on a sci-fi novel, this game introduced the demon recruitment and fusion system. Players navigate 3D-style corridors, negotiating with monsters to build a powerful party to save humanity.

nombre: Digital Devil Story - Megami Tensei II (Japan)
objetivo: Navigate a post-apocalyptic Tokyo to defeat demonic forces and survive.
descripcion_corta: A massive 8-bit RPG sequel featuring a dark story and deep demon fusion mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Megami Tensei II expanded the scope of the original with a top-down world map and even more complex demon interactions. It is highly regarded for its mature storytelling and challenging strategic combat.

objetivo: Explore the labyrinth of Galgalim to defeat Lucifer and his demon army.
descripcion_corta: The fan-translated English version of the first Megami Tensei game.
descripcion_larga: This translation allows English-speaking players to experience the birth of the "Shin Megami Tensei" legacy, making the complex menus and demon negotiations fully understandable.

objetivo: Stop the crime wave in San Francisco and take down "The Scorpio" killer.
descripcion_corta: A gritty action game based on the iconic Clint Eastwood film character.
descripcion_larga: As Inspector Harry Callahan, players must investigate buildings, engage in shootouts, and manage their health across the city. The game features various weapons and the protagonist's famous .44 Magnum.
